title: Cabinetry Draftsperson VA (Cabinet Vision software Expert)
description:
Type of Work: Full-time

Salary: $10 AUD/hr

Hours per week: 37.5



About Us:

Elite Makeovers is a leading renovation company specializing in creating stunning bathrooms, kitchens, and laundries. We take pride in our commitment to excellence, client satisfaction, and fostering a collaborative work environment. We're seeking a highly skilled Cabinetry Draftsperson VA using Cabinet Vision to join our team and contribute to our vision by delivering exceptional drafting services.



Key Responsibilities:

Create detailed cabinetry designs and plans using Cabinet Vision software.

Produce accurate 2D and 3D drawings, cut lists, and shop drawings for manufacturing and installation.

Interpret architectural plans, client briefs, and design specifications.

Incorporate knowledge of Blum, Häfele, Polytec, and Laminex product ranges into designs.

Ensure compliance with industry standards, manufacturing capabilities, and design principles.

Collaborate with clients, project managers, and team members to finalize designs.

Manage multiple projects and meet deadlines with precision and efficiency.



Qualifications and Skills:

Proficiency in Cabinet Vision software is mandatory.

Extensive knowledge of cabinetry materials, construction methods, and design standards.

Familiarity with the Blum, Häfele, Polytec, and Laminex product ranges, including hardware, fittings, and finishes.

Strong understanding of ergonomics, functionality, and aesthetics in cabinetry design.

Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in drafting.

Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically under pressure.

Strong organizational and time-management skills to handle multiple tasks efficiently.

Effective communication skills to work with clients and team members remotely.

Self-motivated and able to work independently in a virtual environment.



Preferred Qualifications:

3 years experience with Cabinet Vision

Has cabinet making experience - how cabinets are made and installed

Prior experience working in the cabinetry or kitchen manufacturing industry.

A background in interior design, architecture, or related fields.

Knowledge of additional design software (e.g., AutoCAD, SketchUp) is a plus.



What We Offer:

A flexible, remote working arrangement.

Competitive compensation based on experience and skill level.

Opportunity to work with a passionate and innovative team.

Career development and growth within a dynamic company.

Remote | Part-time to full-time





WHY WORK WITH US



We are a growing, bootstrapped SaaS company serving thousands of Shopify merchants.



You will own the content that builds our authority: blog articles, LinkedIn posts, customer
s, and the presence that makes merchants trust us before they ever install our app.



This is not a role where you wait for a brief and fill in the blanks. We are looking for someone who can learn a technical domain, d
 what is worth writing about, and produce original, credible content without needing everything handed to them. If we have to spell out every article for you, the role has no point.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



Your job is to keep our content consistent, credible, and actually relevant to what our product does.



- Write blog posts, starting from your own keyword research into topics genuinely relevant to our product and its space, not generic filler chosen to hit a word count

 to our customers and subscribers

s

WHAT GOOD PERFORMANCE LOOKS LIKE



Content ships consistently without anyone chasing it. The topics are ones our customers would actually search for, the writing is accurate about a technical product, and readers come away trusting us. Over time you need less direction, not more.





REQUIREMENTS



- Excellent written English with a clear, credible, non-fluffy voice



- Able to learn a technical domain and write about it accurately without a subject expert walking you through every detail



- Strong research skills, including keyword research that reflects real search intent

title: eCommerce Video Editor
description:
PAID SOCIAL CREATIVE EDITOR – AI VIDEO & STATIC ADS



We are a fast-growing eCommerce brand that produces high-volume Meta ads and is seeking an exceptionally skilled Paid Social Creative Editor who can produce AI-enhanced video ads and static creatives at scale.



This role is for someone who understands direct-response marketing, fast-paced iteration, and AI generation workflows, not basic aesthetic editing.



This is intended to be a long-term role. We want someone who can grow with the team, improve their creative and performance-marketing skills, and gradually take on greater creative responsibility as the company grows.



You will receive training on our internal creative systems, brand, workflows, testing process and the way we use AI tools. However, this is not a beginner editing role. You should already have strong fundamental editing ability and be capable of independently executing creative briefs.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



• Create high-volume paid social videos, including:

  - UGC-style ads

  - Product demos

  - Problem–solution ads

  - Voiceover visuals

  - Testimonial edits



• Generate AI-powered visuals using tools such as:

  - Google Veo 3

  - Higgsfield

  - Google Gemini

  - AI UGC/avatar tools

  - AI image generators



• Build static ads using a mix of AI visuals and our existing asset library.



• Receive a creative brief including a concept, angle and script, then independently produce:

  - 3–10 video variations

  - 5–20 static image variations

  - Rapid iterations based on feedback and performance data



• Add engaging on-screen text, captions, VFX and sound design.



• Incorporate our pre-existing footage alongside newly generated AI elements.



• Help conceptualize ideas that improve CTR, hook rate, thumbstop ratio and ROAS.



• Deliver creatives in a Meta-native format: short-form, mobile-first, bold text and fast pacing.



• Learn our internal creative-testing process and improve your ability to turn performance data into stronger creative iterations.



• Over time, take greater ownership over execution, creative systems and potentially parts of the creative strategy as your abilities develop.



REQUIRED SKILLS + EXPERIENCE



Please do not apply if you do not meet the criteria.



DIRECT-RESPONSE CREATIVE EDITING



• Knowledge of high-performing Meta ad formats.

• Strong understanding of:

  - Hooks

  - Pacing

  - Retention strategy

  - CTA placement



AI VIDEO & IMAGE GENERATION – ADVANCED



• Strong prompting abilities.

• Ability to generate:

  - AI actors / UGC avatars

  - AI B-roll

  - AI product shots

• Workflow experience including:

  - Storyboarding

  - Prompt crafting

  - Refining generations

  - Upscaling

  - Incorporating generated assets into finished ads



TECHNICAL EDITING SOFTWARE SKILLS



Experience with professional editing tools such as:



• Adobe Premiere Pro

• CapCut Desktop

• DaVinci Resolve

• Final Cut Pro



And static/design tools such as:



• Photoshop

• Canva

• Figma



You do not need to use every editing platform listed above, but you should be highly proficient with your primary editing workflow.



You must be able to sync voiceovers accurately and maintain strong pacing throughout an ad.



PAID SOCIAL CREATIVE KNOWLEDGE



• Understanding of creative testing.

• Ability to interpret creative performance metrics such as:

  - Hook rate

  - Thumbstop percentage

  - CTR

  - Watch-time drop-off



WORK SPEED



• MUST be able to produce high-volume output consistently.

• Must be capable of turning around creative requests within 24–48 hours.

• Must be comfortable producing multiple variations of a concept rather than treating every ad as a one-off edit.



ENGLISH PROFICIENCY



• Must be able to communicate proficiently in English verbally and over text.

• Must be able to understand creative briefs, scripts and detailed feedback without constant supervision.



TRAINING + DEVELOPMENT



There will be an onboarding and training period where you will learn:



• Our products and customer

• Our brand and creative standards

• Our internal creative workflows

• How we structure and test Meta creatives

• Our AI-generation workflows

• How we review performance and iterate creatives



We expect you to actively improve your skills as the role develops.



We are looking for someone who wants to become significantly better at performance creative, AI-assisted production and direct-response advertising over the next 6–12+ months, rather than someone looking for short-term freelance projects.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



You can take a brief or completed script and independently turn it into several high-quality finished ads.



You understand WHY different creative choices are being made rather than simply following editing instructions.



You can generate or source the assets needed to execute a concept.



You work quickly without allowing quality to collapse.



You respond well to feedback and can rapidly iterate.



You become increasingly capable of identifying opportunities to improve hooks, pacing, visual execution and overall ad performance.



APPLICATION PROCESS



Please apply using the form below:




(remove spaces)



The application asks for your portfolio, direct-response experience, AI-generation experience, workflow, availability and several short creative-thinking questions.



Please submit your strongest work rather than sending a large generic portfolio.



Strong applicants will progress to an interview and may then be invited to complete a paid editing test.

title: Part-Time SEO Specialist
description:
Marketix Digital is an Australian SEO and Search Intelligence agency.



We work with established Australian businesses and are moving further towards mid-market and enterprise clients where SEO needs to connect directly to commercial outcomes, search demand, competitive intelligence and revenue.



We are not looking for someone who simply follows a checklist.



We want someone who understands SEO, can execute well, can learn our systems quickly, and can gradually take ownership of increasingly important work.



You will work closely with our Senior SEO Strategist and Managing Director.



What You Will Be Doing



Initially, your work will include:



SEO Execution

On-page SEO optimisation

Keyword and search intent research

Keyword mapping

Internal linking

Content optimisation and refreshes

Google Search Console analysis

Identifying pages with ranking and traffic opportunities

Competitor and SERP analysis

Basic technical SEO investigation

Supporting implementation of SEO recommendations

Content & Topical Authority

Researching topical clusters

Generating cluster content opportunities

Writing and optimising cluster content

Creating statistics-based content

Researching commercially valuable content topics

Supporting content designed around actual customer and executive decision-making questions

Digital PR & Authority Building

Finding and answering relevant Featured Questions / journalist requests

Guest post prospecting

Outreach and negotiation with websites

Supporting guest article creation

Link opportunity research

Original data and research projects

Reverse digital PR campaigns



We already have SOPs for many of these processes, so you will not be starting without direction.



As you become more capable, we want you to move beyond task execution and begin identifying SEO opportunities yourself.



What We Are Looking For



You should already have practical SEO experience.



Ideally, you have experience with several of the following:



Google Search Console

GA4

Ahrefs

SEMrush

Screaming Frog

WordPress

Keyword research

On-page SEO

Technical SEO

Content optimisation

Internal linking

Link building or digital PR

Competitor analysis



You do not need to be an expert at everything.



What matters more is that you understand how SEO works, can think logically, communicate clearly and improve quickly.



The Type of Person We Want



You will probably be a good fit if you:



Think independently rather than waiting for every instruction

Pay attention to details

Can follow an SOP accurately

Ask intelligent questions when something genuinely isn't clear

Understand search intent rather than just inserting keywords

Can research unfamiliar industries

Are comfortable working with data

Take ownership of your work

Can explain why you are recommending something

Want to become considerably better at SEO



We care about quality much more than simply completing a large number of tasks.



What This Role Is Not



This is not a VA role.



It is not a pure content writing role.



It is not a role where you will simply be given keywords and asked to produce articles all day.



We are looking for someone who can develop into a strong SEO practitioner.



How to Apply



Your application subject line must contain the word: ENTITY



If ENTITY is not in your subject line, your application will not be considered.



Please answer the following questions in your application:



How many years of hands-on SEO experience do you have?

What SEO tools do you regularly use?

Tell us about the most technically difficult SEO problem you have personally worked on. What was wrong, how did you diagnose it, and what did you do?

Give an example of a page or website where your SEO work produced a measurable result. What changed?

If a page ranks in positions 8–15 for an important commercial keyword, how would you d
 what to do next?

Which part of SEO are you strongest at?

Which part of SEO are you weakest at?

What is your current employment situation and availability?

Are you comfortable working 20 hours per week for ₱30,000 PHP per month?

Important Application Requirement



Write your application yourself.



Do not use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or any other AI writing tool to generate, rewrite or improve your application answers.



We want to assess how you think, communicate and understand SEO.



If we determine that your application has been generated or rewritten using AI, your application will be immediately rejected.



Your English does not need to be perfect. We would much rather read an imperfect answer written by you than a polished answer written by an AI.



Short, specific and genuine answers are preferred over long generic ones.



Remember: ENTITY must appear in your application subject line.

description:
We're seeking a passionate and culturally attuned Music Publicist to champion Australian artists in international markets. This is a flexible freelance role at 2 hours per day, perfect for someone who lives and breathes contemporary music.



Your primary mission is to secure press coverage and media placement for Australian artists across the USA, UK, Australia, and Southeast Asia. You'll be the bridge between our artists and the right publications, journalists, bloggers, and influencers, identifying opportunities and crafting compelling pitches that resonate with each platform's unique audience.



What You'll Do

● Develop and execute targeted media strategies for Australian artists seeking international exposure

● Identify and pitch to relevant publications, journalists, influencers, and media outlets across USA, UK, Australia, and Southeast Asia

● Craft compelling, platform-specific press releases and pitch copy that captures an artist's essence and demographic appeal

● Maintain a deep, current understanding of music media landscape across multiple regions, from traditional publications to emerging digital platforms

● Leverage knowledge of Instagram and TikTok influencer ecosystems to identify collaboration and coverage opportunities

● Build and nurture relationships with key media contacts and influencers

● Analyze artist demographics and tailor pitches to reach the right audience on the right platform

● Communicate professionally via
 and maintain detailed campaign records



What We're Looking For

Essential

● Deep understanding of contemporary music culture and the current music media landscape

● Expertise in music-focused platforms on Instagram and TikTok—including understanding influencer ecosystems and how they impact music discovery

● Strong copywriting skills with the ability to adapt tone and messaging for different publications and audiences

● Meticulous attention to detail and organizational skills

● Excellent written communication via
; ability to craft professional, personalized pitches

● Genuine love of music and demonstrated cultural awareness of modern, contemporary artists

● Ability to analyze artist demographics and identify the right platforms and publications for placement

● Familiarity with USA, UK, and Australian music press landscapes



Desirable

● Previous experience in music PR, music journalism, or music media

● Established relationships with music journalists, bloggers, or influencers

● Familiarity with Southeast Asian music media landscape

● Knowledge of music industry trends and emerging artist markets



Application Screening Question

To help us assess your fit, please respond to the following before submitting your CV:

An Australian artist we're working with creates dreamy indie electronic songs blending post-punk textures, warped electronics, and unexpectedly tender pop moments. Their sound is experimental, conceptual, and deeply influenced by '80s acts like Blue Nile and Prefab Sprout. They're at the intersection of dream pop, art pop, and hypnagogic pop… introspective, hazy, and emotionally nuanced.



Where would you pitch this artist to get press coverage in the USA, UK, and Australia? Please name at least 10 specific publications, platforms, or journalists/influencers, explain why each would be a good fit for this artist, and outline your pitch approach for each.



Position Details

title: Client Advisor | Luxury Watches & Fine Jewelry
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a Los Angeles-based luxury watch and fine jewelry dealership. Our clients spend five and six figures on a single purchase, and almost every one of those conversations happens in writing — marketplace messages, text threads, and website inquiries. Right now, one person handles all of it. We need a second.



You will be the voice our clients read. That means your written English cannot be good for a second language. It needs to read like a sharp, articulate American professional — warm without overdoing it, concise without sounding abrupt. No stiff phrasing, no template energy, no over-formality.



You do not need to know anything about luxury watches — we will teach you the product, the policies, and the workflow. Experience in luxury goods, high-value e-commerce, or premium retail is a real plus, but it will never outweigh how you write. We cannot teach you how to write, how to read a room, or how to sense when a buyer is hesitating.



You will not be working the night alone. We already have a team in the Philippines, and you will join it with guided training, reviewed replies, and increasing independence as you demonstrate accuracy and sound judgment.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



• Answer inbound Chrono24, eBay, website, and text inquiries using verified product information — asking useful questions and guiding buyers toward a clear next step

• Handle offers within approved pricing and terms, protecting negotiating room and keeping the conversation respectful

• Follow up on conversations that have gone quiet. As you develop, help reconnect with past clients

• Escalate exceptions with a concise summary, the facts you verified, and a recommended reply ready for approval

• Prepare Canva invoices and FedEx shipping labels from approved transaction details — checking prices, reference numbers, recipients, and addresses before submitting for review

• Hand off unresolved conversations cleanly before ending your shift, and coordinate internally when the same buyer reaches us through multiple channels



Routine questions you answer from approved information. Pricing outside your authority, holds, disputed condition, authenticity concerns, and unusual payment or address requests go to the senior advisor for approval.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



• Flawless written English — grammar, tone, rhythm, and instinct

• Prior experience communicating with clients in writing: chat,
, sales, support, or account management

• Commercial judgment. Someone offers well below asking and you neither cave nor insult them. You can tell when a buyer is hesitating and move the conversation forward without discounting or pressure

• Accuracy with prices, specifications, reference and serial numbers, invoices, and shipping details. You verify what you do not know instead of guessing

• Knowing the limits of your own authority. Escalating well matters more here than being fast

• Dependable handoffs, prompt flagging of your own mistakes, and feedback applied the first time

• Curiosity about the product, discretion with client information, and long-term intent. We are building a team, not filling a seat



SCHEDULE



Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Pacific, 40 hours per week. In the Philippines those shifts land Tuesday to Saturday:

• 12:00 AM – 8:00 AM Philippine time during US daylight saving, roughly March to November

• 1:00 AM – 9:00 AM Philippine time during US standard time, roughly November to March



Please apply only if a permanent night schedule genuinely works for your life. This is the single most common reason these roles fail, and we would rather you self-select out now than burn out in month three. Prior experience on US hours helps.



YOUR SETUP



Going dark mid-shift is not survivable in this role.



• A computer that comfortably runs multiple browser tabs, messaging tools, and Canva

• Primary internet of at least 25 Mbps down / 10 Mbps up, plus a usable backup such as mobile data or a second provider

• Backup power for both your computer and your internet equipment — tell us how long your setup actually lasts in an outage

• A quiet, dedicated workspace. You will be handling live client conversations

If your connection or power fails: notify the team immediately on the agreed backup channel, switch to your backup setup, and arrange coverage if you cannot resume. Communicating the problem is part of the job.



COMPENSATION AND GROWTH



• $800 USD per month to start. Straight salary, no commission.

• A paid one-week trial at the equivalent of your full salary rate. It is structured so you build up gradually rather than being dropped into live client work on day one

• A formal performance and compensation review at 90 days. An increase is not automatic. It is earned on: accuracy of replies and documents, response time during your shift, dependable follow-up and handoffs, quality of your escalation drafts, and how many routine conversations you handle correctly without senior intervention

• Paid time off after probation and paid Philippine holidays. The PTO allowance, probation length, pay schedule, and holiday coverage are specified in the written offer before your trial



We value mistakes caught and reported early far more than a spotless record with surprises in it.



CONFIDENTIALITY AND OUTSIDE WORK



• Your scheduled hours require your full attention, with no overlapping paid work

• No concurrent work for another watch or jewelry dealer, no personal buying or selling of watches or jewelry for resale, and no soliciting our clients for outside business

• Unrelated work outside your scheduled hours is fine as long as it does not affect your availability or performance here

• Client names, purchase histories, pricing, and internal records stay confidential. A confidentiality agreement and system access are completed before any trial work touching real client information



HOW TO APPLY



Start your subject line with MERIDIAN so we know you read this all the way through. Applications without the correct subject line, or the section below, will not be read.



Write four replies exactly as you would send them to a real client. Write the actual message, not a description of what you would say. Use only the facts given — do not invent policies, product details, guarantees, or approvals. Keep each reply under 100 words, and write them yourself.



1. A watch is listed at $22,000. A new buyer opens with: “Best price? Cash today.” No greeting, no other context. You can confirm the listing price and ask questions, but any discount needs advisor approval.

2. A client you have never spoken to writes: “How do I know this is real and not a fake? No offense but I’ve been burned before.”

3. Ten days ago a client told you they were “very interested” in a piece and would confirm by the weekend. They have not replied since. Write the message that reopens the conversation.

4. A client asks you to hold a $40,000 watch for a week with no deposit while he sells another watch, and hints he will walk if you say no. You cannot approve a hold and the advisor has not reviewed it yet.



Then a short introduction covering:

• Your relevant written client-service or sales experience

• Why a permanent night shift works for your situation

• Your earliest start date, and confirmation that the $800 monthly starting salary works for you

• Your computer, primary and backup internet, and how long your backup power actually lasts



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



Shortlisted candidates do a short live writing exercise — about ten minutes, at a time we arrange with you. We send you several client messages from our inbox and you reply to them. No preparation and no generative AI. It is the same work you would be doing on the job, which is exactly the point.



Strong candidates go to a reference check. We ask former employers about your written client work and your reliability on a night schedule, so please have two contactable references ready.



From there, a paid one-week trial at your full rate. It is staged, so nothing lands on you cold:



• Days 1–2: reading. Our written standards, our policies, and a few hundred real past client threads so you can hear how we sound

• Days 3–4: you draft replies to live inquiries. Our senior advisor reviews everything before it sends, so you can be wrong without consequence

• Day 5: you start sending directly on routine conversations, with the harder ones still drafted for approval



You get feedback every day, not at the end. We are watching how quickly you pick up the voice, how you handle correction, and whether your judgment holds up when a conversation gets awkward. If it is working, we move you onto the full role at the end of the week. 



Thank you for your time!

title: LinkedIn Outreach & Founder Engagement
description:
About Founders & Funders



Founders & Funders is a growing community that brings together high-potential founders, venture capital firms, and strategic partners through curated events, meaningful introductions, and relationship-driven experiences. We are looking for an experienced **LinkedIn Outreach & Founder Engagement** who can help us identify, engage, and invite the right founders to our events.



This is not simply a high-volume outreach role. We need someone who understands how to find qualified founders, create communications that feel personal and relevant, and build outreach systems that consistently generate strong responses and event registrations.



What You’ll Own



Founder Research and Targeting

- Identify founders who match the specific criteria, audience, and goals of each event.

- Build highly targeted prospect lists using LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, databases, AI tools, and other research platforms.

- Evaluate founder quality based on factors such as company stage, revenue, funding, industry, location, and overall event fit.

- Continuously improve targeting strategies based on registration quality and campaign performance.



LinkedIn Outreach and Engagement

- Create personalized LinkedIn outreach campaigns that capture founders’ attention and encourage meaningful responses.

- Write creative invitations, follow-ups, and engagement sequences that feel warm, relevant, and human.

- Adapt messaging for different founder segments, industries, funding stages, and event formats.

- Engage prospects through both automated and manual outreach while maintaining a high level of personalization.

- Build genuine relationships with founders—not simply send connection requests or generic messages.



Automation, AI, and Campaign Systems

- Use LinkedIn outreach and automation platforms such as Ulinc or similar tools to build and manage campaigns.

- Use AI strategically for research, personalization, message development, segmentation, and campaign optimization.

- Create repeatable outreach workflows that allow the team to scale without sacrificing message quality.

- Monitor platform limitations and LinkedIn best practices to maintain account safety and campaign effectiveness.

- Test new tools, systems, and approaches that can improve founder acquisition.



Lead Generation and Performance

- Own outreach performance from prospect identification through registration.

- Track key metrics such as connection acceptance, response rate, qualified conversations, registrations, approvals, and attendance.

- Run regular message and campaign tests to improve results.

- Identify why campaigns are performing well or underperforming and recommend solutions.

- Provide clear updates on results, challenges, learnings, and next steps.



Leadership and Team Development

- Help establish outreach standards, processes, templates, and best practices.

- Coach and support other team members involved in founder research and outreach.

- Review outreach quality and help the team improve targeting, messaging, and follow-up.

- Take increasing ownership of the overall founder outreach strategy as the organization grows.

- Develop into a future leader who can eventually manage and strengthen the Founder Outreach team.



What We’re Looking For

- Proven experience in LinkedIn outreach, lead generation, founder acquisition, business development, or a related role.

- Advanced knowledge of LinkedIn and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

- Experience using LinkedIn automation platforms such as Ulinc or similar tools.

- Strong understanding of outreach automation, AI-assisted workflows, CRM systems, and lead-generation platforms.

- Excellent writing skills, with the ability to create communications that are engaging, personalized, and not overly sales-driven.

- Experience building and optimizing multi-step outreach campaigns.

- Strong research skills and the ability to distinguish qualified prospects from high-volume lists.

- Comfortable working with performance metrics and making decisions based on campaign data.

- Highly organized, resourceful, proactive, and able to manage multiple campaigns at once.

- Strong judgment when balancing automation with thoughtful, human engagement.

- Leadership potential and a genuine interest in coaching others and improving team performance.



What Success Looks Like

title: Client Success Manager – $2,000/month Base + Uncapped Commissions (USD)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.

- Growth opportunity into leadership

title: Part-Time Customer Support Specialist | Premium U.S. Wellness Brand | Stripe & Subscriptions
description:
Part-Time Customer Support Specialist | Premium U.S. Wellness Brand | Stripe & Subscriptions



**IMPORTANT: If you applied to our previous Forma Pilates Customer Support Specialist posting, please do not apply again. Your original application remains under consideration. This posting is intended to reach additional candidates with direct Stripe and subscription-billing experience.**



Forma Pilates is hiring a reliable, thoughtful Customer Support and Subscription Operations Specialist to become the primary owner and gatekeeper of our shared customer-support inbox.



You will be the first point of contact for Forma’s digital customers. You will triage incoming messages, resolve issues within your authority, route specialized cases to the correct person, and make sure nothing is forgotten or left without a response.



This is not a general virtual-assistant position. Much of the work involves subscription billing, cancellations, refunds, trial conversions, payment problems, account access, technical troubleshooting, and member retention.



Position details



- Part-time: approximately 20–21 hours per week

- Compensation: $5–$6 USD per hour, depending on directly relevant experience

- Coverage is required seven days per week, including weekends

- Approximately three working hours per day

- Long-term opportunity for the right person



Please apply only if the compensation and schedule are genuinely sustainable for you long-term.



Daily schedule



The approximately three daily hours are divided across three scheduled inbox checks:



- 3:00–4:00 PM U.S. Pacific Time

- 6:30–7:30 PM U.S. Pacific Time

- 9:30–10:30 PM U.S. Pacific Time



The purpose is to provide multiple response opportunities throughout the U.S. afternoon and evening—not one continuous three-hour shift.



Pacific Time changes seasonally, so the equivalent Philippine hours will shift by one hour. You must be able to cover all three daily windows consistently, including Saturdays and Sundays.



Customer messages received before the final daily inbox check should receive a meaningful same-day response and initial action.



If a case cannot be resolved that day, the customer should receive a clear update, and the case must have a documented next step, owner, and follow-up deadline.



Primary inbox ownership



You will serve as the gatekeeper for our shared customer-support inbox. Your responsibilities will include:



- Reviewing and triaging incoming customer
s

- Identifying billing, technical, account, e-commerce, and non-support inquiries

- Responding directly when an issue falls within your authority

- Routing specialized inquiries to the correct team member

- Gathering the necessary information before escalating

- Identifying urgent, sensitive, high-value, or recurring problems

- Maintaining a clear owner, next action, status, and deadline for every unresolved case

- Following up internally when another person’s help is required

- Returning to the customer with a complete resolution

- Preventing duplicate replies, conflicting answers, and dropped conversations

- Documenting recurring issues and recommending process improvements



Escalating a case does not end your responsibility. You remain the customer-facing owner until the issue is resolved and confirmed.



 Subscription and billing responsibilities



- Subscription cancellations, refunds, renewals, upgrades, pauses, and plan changes

- Trial-conversion and promotional-pricing questions

- Failed payments, duplicate charges, invoices, and payment-method problems

- Stripe customer, subscription, invoice, refund, and payment investigations

- Reconciling billing records with customer accounts

- Customers who paid successfully but do not have the correct access

- Web-billed versus Apple-billed subscription issues

- Duplicate or mismatched customer accounts

- Login, account, and app-access troubleshooting

- Shopify and physical-order inquiries when needed

- Clear internal documentation, escalation, and follow-through



 Retention responsibilities



Retention is a central part of this role.



When a member wants to cancel, you should be able to:



- Identify the customer’s actual reason for leaving

- Resolve billing or technical problems before assuming the customer wants to leave

- Offer a relevant plan change, pause, discount, or other authorized option

- Explain the value clearly without pressuring or obstructing the customer

- Recognize when retention is inappropriate and honor a clear cancellation request

- Execute the agreed solution and confirm that it was completed

- Document the outcome and any required follow-up



We are looking for thoughtful retention judgment—not aggressive sales tactics or unauthorized promises.



What we are looking for



- Excellent written English that sounds natural, clear, and human

- Experience managing a Gmail, Google Workspace, or shared customer-support inbox

- Strong organization, prioritization, and triage skills

- Sound judgment when customer claims and system records conflict

- Demonstrated customer-retention experience

- Direct experience with recurring subscriptions, billing, and refunds

- Strong ownership and dependable follow-through

- Ability to investigate carefully without making unsupported assumptions

- Reliable availability for all three scheduled daily inbox checks

- Good judgment when handling private customer and account information

- A genuine interest in stable, long-term work



Systems experience



Direct, hands-on Stripe experience is strongly preferred and is a major advantage.



We especially value candidates who have personally worked with:



- Customer and subscription records

- Invoices and payment timelines

- Refunds and disputed charges

- Failed payments and payment methods

- Trials, discounts, renewals, and cancellations

- Duplicate or mismatched customer accounts



Experience with Shopify and Intercom is helpful.



Intercom is straightforward to learn, so previous Intercom experience is not required.



RevenueCat experience is a bonus but is not required. Candidates will not be penalized for lacking RevenueCat experience.



Candidates without Stripe experience may still apply if they have strong, directly comparable recurring-subscription and billing experience. General customer-service experience without subscription-billing or shared-inbox ownership is unlikely to be sufficient.



How to apply



Use this exact subject line:



**STRIPE + INBOX OWNERSHIP — [Your Name]**



Answer every section below in your own words. Keep your answers specific and concise.



Applications that omit a section, use the wrong subject line, or do not follow the instructions will not be considered.



1. Previous application



Confirm that you did not apply to our previous Forma Pilates Customer Support Specialist posting.



If you previously applied, do not submit another application. Your original application is already under consideration.



2. Stripe experience



Describe exactly what you have personally done inside Stripe.



Include:



- Which Stripe records and functions you used

- The types of subscription and billing problems you investigated

- Which actions you were authorized to take

- How frequently and for approximately how long you used Stripe



Do not simply list Stripe as a tool.



If your experience is with another recurring-billing platform, name it and describe the equivalent work you performed.



3. Shared-inbox ownership



Briefly describe a customer-support inbox you personally managed.



Include:



- Approximate daily message volume

- Whether other people shared the inbox

- How you prioritized and organized cases

- How you prevented duplicate replies and dropped conversations

- How you tracked escalations and follow-ups

- Which inbox or support system you used



 4. Retention experience



Describe one real situation in which a customer wanted to cancel.



Explain:



- Why the customer wanted to leave

- How you identified the underlying objection

- What alternative you offered

- Why the offer was appropriate

- Whether the customer remained subscribed

- How you completed and documented the outcome



If retaining the customer was not appropriate, explain why you honored the cancellation instead.



Do not include the customer’s name or personal information.



5. Short customer scenario



A member started a trial and was charged $390 for an annual membership. She says she expected the $50 monthly plan and requests a refund, but adds that she would remain a member if moved to monthly.



Provide:



- The exact response you would send the customer

- What you would investigate before acting

- What you would check in Stripe and the customer’s account

- The action you would take or when you would escalate

- What you must not assume

- How you would attempt to retain the member without creating unnecessary friction



6. Availability and compensation



Confirm:



- That you can reliably cover all three daily inbox windows

- That you can work this schedule seven days per week, including weekends

- Any current job or client commitments that could overlap with these hours

- Your earliest possible start date

- That $5–$6 USD per hour is acceptable and sustainable for you long-term



Applications will be evaluated based on subscription-billing experience, Stripe familiarity, shared-inbox ownership, retention judgment, written communication, problem solving, follow-through, availability, and instruction-following.



Apply Points will be recorded but will not affect who advances.

title: Golf Video Editor | YouTube, Shot Tracers & Motion Graphics
description:
Long Term Golf Video Editor



We’re looking for an experienced GOLF video editor to join our team long term.



This position is specifically for someone who understands golf content and knows how to turn on course footage into polished, engaging YouTube videos and short form content.



This is not a basic social media editing position.



We need someone who understands golf, storytelling, pacing, shot tracers, score graphics, motion graphics, sound design, and cinematic editing.



Editing Style



You should be familiar with content from:



* Bryson DeChambeau

* Grant Horvat

* Adventures in Golf / Erik Anders Lang

* Skratch

* No Laying Up

* Peter Finch

* Rick Shiels



Our content can move between two different styles.



On Course Golf Content



Think Bryson DeChambeau or Grant Horvat.



* Golf matches and challenges

* Playing famous courses

* Hole by hole storytelling

* Shot tracers

* Yardages

* Club selections

* Score graphics

* Hole information

* Reactions

* Golf specific sound design

* Drone footage

* B Roll between shots



Cinematic Golf Films



Think Adventures in Golf, Skratch, and No Laying Up.



These videos focus more on:



* The golf course

* Course history

* Travel

* Architecture

* The overall experience

* Cinematic B Roll

* Drone footage

* Natural sound

* Music

* Storytelling

* Interviews and talking heads



You need to understand when a video should feel energetic and when the footage needs room to breathe.



Golf Editing Experience



Golf editing experience is strongly preferred.



You should understand the natural flow of a golf video without needing every edit explained to you.



For example:



Tee shot ? tracer ? reaction ? second shot ? course B Roll ? approach ? putt ? score update ? next hole.



You should understand basic golf terminology and what viewers care about during a round.



Actually playing golf is a major plus.



Shot Tracers



This is extremely important.



You must be able to create professional looking:



* Ball tracers

* Shot tracers

* Curved shot shapes

* Drives

* Approach shot tracers

* Drone shot tracers when appropriate



The tracer needs to accurately follow the golf ball and shot shape.



We do not want random lines drawn into the sky.



Please provide examples of golf tracers you have personally created.



Golf Motion Graphics



You should be capable of creating clean, modern golf graphics such as:



* Hole number

* Par

* Yardage

* Player score

* Current score to par

* Club selection

* Shot distance

* Carry distance

* Pin location

* Hole maps

* Course maps

* Leaderboards

* Scorecards

* Lower thirds

* Animated typography

* Simple course information graphics



Think professional golf broadcast graphics mixed with modern YouTube golf content.



Nothing cheesy, outdated, or unnecessarily flashy.



Storytelling



We do not want someone who simply cuts clips together.



You should be able to watch footage and recognize:



“This shot needs more buildup.”



“This reaction should stay in.”



“We need B Roll here.”



“This hole is dragging.”



“This drone shot would establish the next hole.”



“This music doesn’t match the scene.”



“This moment needs natural sound instead of music.”



You should be helping build the story, not waiting for instructions on every cut.



Sound Design



Sound design is extremely important.



You should know how to use:



* Golf ball impacts

* Club sounds

* Natural course ambience

* Birds and wind

* Crowd reactions when applicable

* Dialogue

* Subtle risers

* Transitions

* Music

* Sound effects



The goal is immersion, not adding a sound effect every three seconds.



Cinematic Editing



We shoot high quality footage including:



* Sony cameras

* Sony S Log3

* DJI drones

* Multiple camera angles

* Slow motion

* Course B Roll

* Talking heads

* On course audio



You should know how to combine these into a polished golf film.



Color grading experience with Sony S Log3 and DJI footage is a major plus.



We prefer natural, premium looking color instead of aggressive LUTs.



Types of Content



Projects may include:



* Golf course documentaries

* Playing famous golf courses

* Golf challenges

* On course matches

* Course reviews

* Golf travel films

* Golf resort videos

* Equipment testing

* Golf product reviews

* Brand campaigns

* YouTube videos

* Reels

* Shorts

* TikToks



Most importantly, you need to understand golf content.



What We’re Looking For



We want someone who:



* Has professional video editing experience

* Understands golf

* Can create accurate shot tracers

* Can create golf specific motion graphics

* Understands long form YouTube storytelling

* Understands cinematic pacing

* Has strong sound design skills

* Can work with drone footage

* Can organize large amounts of footage

* Pays attention to small details

* Can take feedback without needing every change explained

* Wants consistent long term editing work



Portfolio Requirements



Please send your best relevant examples, especially:



1. Golf videos you have edited

2. Videos containing golf shot tracers

3. Golf motion graphics or score graphics

4. Long form YouTube videos

5. Cinematic or documentary style work



Do not send 20 random editing examples.



We would rather see 3 excellent, relevant projects than a large generic portfolio.



If you have never edited golf content, be upfront about it.



Application Instructions



IMPORTANT: Start your application with the words:



“Grand Geneva”



If your application does not start with Grand Geneva, it will not be reviewed.



Then answer:



1. Link your portfolio.

2. Send your best golf video edit.

3. Send an example of a golf shot tracer you created.

4. What golf creators have you edited for, if any?

5. Do you personally play or follow golf?

6. What editing software do you use?

7. What software or method do you use for shot tracers?

8. Are you experienced with After Effects or similar motion graphics software?

9. How many years have you been editing?

10. How many hours are you available each week?

11. What is your expected hourly rate?

12. Which golf creator or golf channel best represents your editing style and why?



Skills Required



* Video Editing

* Golf Video Editing

* YouTube Video Editing

* Adobe Premiere Pro

* DaVinci Resolve

* Adobe After Effects

* Motion Graphics

* Shot Tracers

This is intended to become a long term position for the right editor.

title: Registered Migration Agent  (AU Experience REQUIRED)
description:
We are seeking an experienced, dynamic, and detail-oriented Registered Migration Agent (RMA) to join our growing legal and migration practice.



In this role, you will manage a diverse portfolio of Australian visa applications, assisting individuals, families, and corporate clients through the complexities of Australia's migration framework. You will work closely with our legal team to provide strategic, accurate, and high-quality migration advice, ensuring positive and timely outcomes for our clients.



Key Responsibilities:



- Client Consultation & Advice: Conduct initial and ongoing consultations with clients to assess migration eligibility, explain complex visa pathways, and recommend tailored strategic solutions.

- Visa Application Management: Prepare, draft, and lodge a wide range of visa applications (including Partner Visas, Employer-Sponsored Visas like TSS/Subclass 482 and ENS/Subclass 186, Skilled Migration, and Student Visas) through the Department of Home Affairs portals.

- Document Verification & Collation: Thoroughly review supporting documentation, statutory declarations, and evidence to ensure strict compliance with the Migration Act 1958 and Migration Regulations 1994.

- Submission Drafting: Write comprehensive, persuasive legal submissions and cover letters supporting complex visa applications or appeals.

- Case Management: Maintain accurate, up-to-date client files and manage deadlines in a fast-paced environment while tracking application progress.

- Regulatory Compliance: Stay fully informed of continuous changes to Australian immigration laws, policies, and procedural instructions, maintaining professional registration standards (OMARA).

- Stakeholder Communication: Liaise professionally with clients, corporate sponsors, the Department of Home Affairs, the Administrative Review Tribunal (ART), and external assessors (e.g., skills assessing bodies).



Key Requirements & Qualifications:



- Current Registration: Must be a current Registered Migration Agent (RMA) with the Office of the Migration Agents Registration Authority (OMARA).

- Experience: Minimum of 2–4 years of post-registration experience managing a diverse caseload of complex visa applications.

- Legal Knowledge: In-depth, practical knowledge of the Migration Act 1958, Migration Regulations, and current Departmental policy guidelines.

- Client-Centric Approach: Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with a compassionate, calm, and professional demeanor when guiding clients through high-stakes life events.

- Organizational Skills: Meticulous attention to detail, exceptional time-management skills, and the ability to manage competing deadlines efficiently.

- Team Player: Collaborative mindset to work effectively alongside lawyers, case managers, and administrative support staff.

title: Global Travel Coordinator
description:
GLOBAL TRAVEL COORDINATOR

Full-time | Permanently remote, Metro Manila

PHP 50,000-65,000 gross monthly base



ICON Global is a U.S.-based private-travel and ground-transportation company headquartered in Palm Beach County, Florida. We coordinate secure ground travel and related services across approximately 1,000 cities worldwide for discerning travelers, executive assistants, families, private-aviation partners, hotels, and other high-touch clients.



We are building a fully remote Global Travel Coordination team in Metro Manila and seek an experienced coordinator who combines operational precision with genuine hospitality. You will help execute complex reservations and live transportation operations, protect every trip handoff, and communicate calmly when plans change.



This is not a generic virtual-assistant, call-center, or data-entry position. It is a permanent, full-time operating role within ICON's travel-coordination function.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Create, update, review, and quality-check ground-transportation reservations.

- Confirm passenger, flight, pickup, vehicle, chauffeur, affiliate, airport, FBO, billing-routing, and special-instruction details within the scope of the role.

- Coordinate service recovery and escalate promptly when a chauffeur, vehicle, affiliate, flight, or itinerary changes.

- Communicate by phone,
, and business messaging with clients, executive assistants, travelers, chauffeurs, affiliates, and hospitality partners.

- Maintain complete notes, handoffs, audit trails, and operational reports.

- Follow ICON standards while applying sound judgment under time pressure.



REQUIRED BACKGROUND



- At least two years of hands-on reservations, dispatch, trip operations, or live service coordination in U.S. chauffeured transportation, NEMT, private aviation/FBO operations, corporate travel, luxury hotel reservations/concierge, or similarly complex premium travel operations.

- Experience supporting U.S. customers in a real-time operating environment.

- Direct chauffeured-transportation and Limo Anywhere experience are strongly preferred.

- Generic BPO or call-center experience alone does not meet the requirement.

- Advanced professional English for live calls and written communication with demanding U.S. and international clients.

- Strong listening comprehension, accuracy, composure, discretion, telephone confidence, prioritization, and follow-through.

- Verifiable employment history and professional references.



REMOTE-WORK AND SCHEDULE REQUIREMENTS



- Residence in Metro Manila and a private, quiet, professional home workspace.

- Reliable primary internet, an independent backup connection, and practical power continuity.

- Regular post-training schedule: Friday-Tuesday, 12:00 a.m.-9:00 a.m. U.S. Eastern Time. This generally corresponds to Friday-Tuesday, 12:00 p.m.-9:00 p.m. Philippine Time during U.S. daylight-saving time and 1:00 p.m.-10:00 p.m. during U.S. standard time.

- The nine-hour span includes an unpaid meal period and eight working hours, subject to final employer documentation.

- Reasonable schedule adjustments may occasionally be required for paid training, operational coverage, daylight-saving transitions, or business needs, with advance notice when practicable and in accordance with Philippine law and the employment agreement.

- Availability for weekends and applicable Philippine holidays that fall on the assigned schedule.

- Willingness to work a temporary paid training schedule with greater overlap with ICON's U.S. team. Exact training days and hours will be provided before acceptance.



COMPENSATION AND EMPLOYMENT



- PHP 50,000-65,000 gross monthly base salary, based on directly relevant experience and demonstrated capability.

- Full-time Philippine employment through ICON's selected local employment partner, with statutory benefits, 13th-month pay, required schedule premiums, and compliant local payroll.

- ICON intends to provide employee HMO coverage, paid vacation and sick leave, and company-managed work equipment. Final benefit and leave details will be confirmed in the written offer.

- Paid training and a structured path for growth through demonstrated operating mastery. This position does not carry automatic managerial authority.



SELECTION PROCESS



The structured process includes application and resume review, short written responses, an unedited audio work sample, interviews, a paid fictional operating simulation for finalists, references, and background and identity verification. No real client information is used in the simulation.



In your application, identify your most relevant transportation or premium-travel employer, the U.S. market or customers you supported, your exact reservation or dispatch responsibilities, and every system you used. Confirm that you can work the stated schedule and briefly describe your primary internet, backup internet, and power-continuity plan.



ICON Global evaluates applicants using job-related criteria and welcomes qualified candidates from all backgrounds.

# AI Avatar Video Editor / Content Creator (Work From Home) — $300 to Start | BLESSA Agency



We're hiring an experienced video editor or AI content creator for a long term, full time role producing AI avatar short form videos. This is not an entry level position, we're looking for someone who already knows their way around CapCut and AI content tools.



## Position

Starting pay is $300 for your first month. Once your content and edits are consistently excellent, pay increases to $400/month. This is a flexible, full time role: as long as you deliver 9 videos a day (63 videos a week), the schedule is yours to manage. Most editors find this takes about 8 hours a day. Payment is sent biweekly via Wise or PayPal only.



## Job Description

You'll take a script and a reference video we provide, break the reference video down scene by scene, recreate each scene using one of our 3 AI avatars, animate it, and edit the finished clips into a polished short form video.



Daily output is 9 videos a day: 3 sets of 2 growth videos and 1 sales video. Videos run 30 seconds to 2 minutes. Full workflow, scripts, references, and tools are provided. You bring the editing eye and keep everything consistent.



## Tools We Provide

- Google Docs and Drive for scripts, references, and delivery

- Nano Banana

- Flow (Veo 3) for animation

- CapCut for final edit

- Full written and video training covering the entire workflow



## Requirements

- Must provide a Drive link or other link with examples of previous work to be considered, no exceptions

- Prior experience editing video and/or creating AI generated content (CapCut experience required, AI tool experience preferred)

- Reliable computer and internet connection

- Able to consistently deliver 9 videos a day (63 a week), roughly 8 hours of focused work, on your own schedule

- Able to keep an avatar visually consistent (same look, same outfit) across an entire video

- Fluent English speaker

- Honest, reliable, and responsive to feedback

-Can communicate fast if needed



## What Makes This Different

This isn't high volume, low effort content. Every video needs to look realistic, avatar consistency has to hold up scene to scene, and edits need to be clean, no visible AI artifacts, no dead air, tight captions, and a small AI disclosure tag on every video. We want someone who takes pride in that level of polish.



## Bonuses

- Sales videos: $50 bonus for any sales video that reaches 100k views, no cap on how many you can earn

- Growth videos: no bonus, these are volume and awareness plays



## Communication

WhatsApp is our main channel.



## Growth Opportunity

Reliable, high quality editors get first access to more daily videos, higher pay, and bigger bonus opportunities as the channel grows. Editors who stay disciplined and creative for 6 months or more have the potential to move into a manager role overseeing other creators.



## How to Apply

Send us:

- Your full name and location

- Your device and internet speed

- A Drive link or other link with examples of previous editing or AI content work (required to be considered)

- Confirmation you can consistently hit 9 videos a day, 63 a week

- Whether you can receive payment via Wise or PayPal

Creative variation

description:
Amazon  / E# Amazon FBA / E-Commerce Sourcing Specialist – Experienced Applicants Only



**Position:** Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage Sourcing Specialist

**Schedule:** Up to 40 hours per week

**Starting Pay:** $3.00–$4.00 USD per hour, based on verified experience and demonstrated ability

**Work Location:** Remote

**Monitoring:** Screen sharing and activity monitoring are required while working



We are hiring an experienced Amazon FBA and e-commerce Sourcing Specialist. This is a performance-based position. Your job is to consistently find qualified, profitable products that our company can purchase and resell.



This is not an entry-level training position. We are not looking for applicants who have only watched Amazon courses or YouTube videos. You must already know how to source independently and correctly analyze products using Keepa and SellerAmp.



## Important: Read Before Applying



Your performance will be evaluated immediately.



If you cannot demonstrate that you know how to source during your first week, your employment may be terminated. If your leads consistently contain incorrect matches, bad calculations, unacceptable risks, or products that do not meet our criteria, you will not remain on the team.



All verified hours worked will be paid. However, dishonesty—including falsifying experience, submitting copied leads, manipulating time records, working multiple jobs during our scheduled hours, or misrepresenting your work—will result in immediate termination.



We monitor day-to-day activity. You must be willing to share your screen while working and use our approved time-tracking and communication systems.



## Responsibilities



* Source profitable Amazon FBA products through online arbitrage and e-commerce websites

* Use manual sourcing, reverse sourcing, storefront stalking, Keepa Product Finder, and other established sourcing methods

* Verify exact product matches, including size, quantity, variation, model number, and UPC

* Analyze Keepa charts, Buy Box history, sales-rank movement, offer count, pricing stability, and Amazon’s presence

* Calculate accurate profit and ROI using SellerAmp

* Evaluate IP complaints, brand restrictions, hazmat concerns, meltable products, expiration dates, and other risks

* Confirm that retailers and suppliers are legitimate

* Submit complete leads using our required format

* Correct mistakes and respond to feedback promptly

* Maintain consistent productivity throughout the workday

* Protect all company information, leads, supplier lists, and sourcing methods



## Minimum Lead Criteria



Unless otherwise instructed, leads should generally meet the following:



* Minimum selling price: $19.99

* Minimum estimated profit: $3.00

* Minimum ROI: 40%

* Minimum estimated sales: 50 units per month

* Stable selling price and Buy Box history

* Exact product match

* Legitimate retailer or supplier

* No unacceptable IP, variation, expiration, hazmat, or authenticity risks



Meeting the minimum numbers does not automatically make a product a good lead. You must also use judgment when evaluating competition, price stability, Amazon’s presence, offer count, inventory depth, and the likelihood that the product will remain profitable.



## Performance Expectations



* Approximately one properly researched lead per working hour

* Leads must be accurate, complete, and realistically purchasable

* Consistent improvement after receiving feedback

* Ability to explain why a product is or is not a good purchase

* Ability to work independently without needing basic sourcing training



The first two weeks are an evaluation period. Candidates who cannot consistently find qualified leads, repeatedly submit inaccurate work, or require training in basic sourcing will be released.



## Required Experience



* Previous hands-on Amazon FBA online-arbitrage sourcing experience

* Strong working knowledge of Keepa and SellerAmp

* Ability to read Keepa charts without assistance

* Understanding of Amazon fees, profit, ROI, sales estimates, and Buy Box behavior

* Strong written English and communication skills

* Reliable computer and internet connection

* Willingness to share your screen and have work activity monitored

* Ability to follow detailed sourcing criteria and accept direct feedback



## Do Not Apply If



* You have never independently sourced profitable Amazon FBA products

* Your experience consists mainly of courses, videos, or unpaid practice

* You need training on the basics of Keepa or SellerAmp

* You submit leads sourced by another VA, group, or paid lead list

* You plan to work another job during our scheduled hours

* You are unwilling to share your screen or use time-tracking software

* You exaggerate your experience or use AI-generated answers to hide a lack of knowledge



## How to Apply



Include the following:



1. Your full name and location

2. Your requested hourly rate

3. Your years of Amazon FBA sourcing experience

4. The sourcing methods you have personally used

5. Your experience with Keepa and SellerAmp

6. Your average number of qualified leads produced per eight-hour shift

7. Your typical weekly purchasing volume generated for previous clients

8. A screenshot of a Keepa chart with your written analysis

9. A short explanation of how you evaluate price stability and competition

10. The phrase **“Accuracy Before Quantity”** at the beginning of your application



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered. Selected applicants must complete a timed sourcing assessment before receiving an employment offer.

title: Academic Research Assistant (Psychology Graduate) – Research Methods & Quiz, Surveys, and Polls Creation
description:
Type: Part-Time / Project-Based (10–15 hours/week to start)

Salary: $6.00 – $9.00 USD / hour (depending on degree level and experience)



Job Description: We are seeking a detail-oriented Virtual Assistant with a strong background in Psychology to assist with course preparation for Research Methods in Psychology courses. This role combines academic literature processing with straightforward EdTech administrative tasks.



Key responsibilities for this gig: 



1. Content Extraction & Google Forms Setup (Academic Extraction):

- Read provided psychology research papers (focusing on Method, Measures, and Appendices sections).

-  Extract survey items, manipulation check questions, scale anchors (e.g., Likert scales), and multiple-choice options.

- Organize questions into a Master Google Sheet, ensuring strict accuracy for answer keys, reverse-scored items, and technical terminology for automated Google Forms generation.



2. Poll Everywhere & PowerPoint Integration (Easy Mechanical Setup):

- Take the provided question sets, desired formats, and answer keys, and upload/import them directly into Poll Everywhere.

- Share the created Poll Everywhere activities with the lead instructor's account.

- Embed/upload the live Poll Everywhere activities directly into the provided PowerPoint lecture slides.



Qualifications:

- Education: Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Psychology, Psychometrics, or Behavioral Sciences (required).

- Strong understanding of psychological research designs (e.g., hypothesis definitions, operational definitions, survey-based data collection).

- Excellent written English and academic literacy.

- Comfort with Google Sheets/Excel, Google Forms, and Microsoft PowerPoint (Poll Everywhere is free and easy to use)

- High attention to detail (zero tolerance for typos or altered scientific phrasing).



How to Apply:

- Reply with a brief introduction outlining your educational background in Psychology.

- Mention your experience with research methods or statistics coursework.

- Start your response with the words "Psychology VA" so I know you read the full posting. Shortlisted candidates will complete a brief 10-minute paid screening task.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Executive Assistant to our Head of Brand & Customer

Reports to: Head of Brand & Customer, Exec Team Member



We're looking for an Executive Assistant who thinks like an operator, not someone who just keeps things administered. If

you're early in your career but have already proven you can run point on something real — coordinating a team, managing

client relationships, keeping a fast-moving project from falling apart — read on, even if “assistant” has never quite

captured what you actually did in your last role.



Company

Manukora — the world's best Mānuka honey & functional wellness brand and leading Mānuka brand in the USA.

About Manukora



Manukora is a New Zealand-based Manuka honey brand on a mission to bring the world's most authentic, ethically

sourced honey to people who care about what they put in their bodies. We sell direct-to-consumer, on Amazon, and

through retail partners across the US, GCC, and UK. We're a fast-growing team that moves with urgency, values real

relationships, and sets the bar — not just meets it.



Learn more: 
 
 on Instagram



About the opportunity

This is not a calendar-and-inbox job, even though the calendar and inbox are part of it. It's the chance to become the right

hand of a senior brand and marketing leader at one of the fastest-growing wellness brands in the US — and to build your

own career alongside hers.

We're looking for someone sharp and driven, still early in their career, who already has an operator's instinct: you think in

systems, you move fast, and you take complete ownership of whatever lands in front of you. You don't need years of

experience running a business — you need to have already shown, in whatever you've done, that people can hand you

something real and trust it'll get done right.

Some of our strongest people came into roles like this from client success, coordination, operations support, or fast-paced

generalist roles — not necessarily from a traditional EA background. We care far more about your judgment and your

instinct for ownership than we do about your job title so far.

The scope is deliberately broad and the ceiling is high: project coordination, meeting preparation, marketing operations,

communications, travel, and the systems that hold it all together. The better you anticipate, the more you will own.

For the right person, this is a launchpad, not a ceiling.



What you'll own

• Project & team coordination. Keeping projects, deadlines, and follow-ups on track across the team so the executive

is freed from chasing and project-managing others. You are the person who knows the status of everything and makes

sure nothing stalls.

• Meeting readiness & agenda-setting. Not just a tidy calendar, but real preparation — because you have full context

on what's going on, you help set agendas, build briefing notes, and ensure the executive walks into every meeting

fully prepared.

• Marketing & production operations. Coordinating production, sourcing and negotiating with suppliers, vetting

talent, and running outreach and organisation for marketing activities. You will engage with the work, not just

administer it.

• Systems & process building. Turning recurring work into documented, repeatable systems — for the inbox, travel,

projects and reporting — so problems get solved once rather than managed forever. Where a tool or an AI workflow

can do the job, you build it.

• Communications on her behalf. As trust is built, you draft and send replies that are an accurate representation of her

voice, and proactively reach out to people on her behalf to keep things moving.

• The trust foundation: inbox, calendar and travel. Everything above depends on this being flawless, because this is

where trust gets built first. Nothing missed, lost, mis-filed, or a
 archived or sent to spam. Inbox tightly

triaged with a clear understanding of who the key contacts are and how each should be handled. Drafts prepared in

anticipation of responses. Calendar planned and protected 2–4+ weeks ahead, with detailed context built into every

entry (interview notes, meeting agendas, dial-in details, prep links). Trips documented and planned end-to-end, with

accommodation options presented and preferences learned and refined over time. Personal administration handled

without it ever needing to be asked for.



Who you are

• A fast learner who increases the executive's bandwidth from day one — not someone who needs to ask questions on

everything.

• You take full ownership and run with ambiguity. You make sound calls, bring recommendations rather than open-

ended problems, and only escalate when you genuinely should.

• You anticipate needs, spot risks early, and prepare before being asked.

• You are exceptionally organised and pride yourself on it, with a very high level of comprehension and an instinct for

systems that prevent problems recurring.

• You communicate with precision and structure — clear, concise, and proactive.

• You're hungry and driven — building a long-term career alongside a senior leader genuinely excites you, not just as a

line on a resume.



Experience

• A couple of years of real, hands-on exposure to a fast-paced business — that could be client success, operations or

project coordination, account management, a startup generalist role, or executive support. We're open on the path:

what matters is evidence of real responsibility, not the title.

• A demonstrable track record of owning outcomes rather than tasks: making decisions, coordinating other people, and

being trusted with things that mattered.

• Evidence of building or improving how something runs — a process, a system, a workflow — not just executing an

existing one.

• Excellent written English and communication.

• Comfortable with AI tools and structured workflow tools (Notion or similar).

• A bachelor's degree, or an equivalent track record that speaks for itself.



How to Apply:



Send an
 directly to 

Subject Line: Executive Assistant to Head of Brand - [Your Full Name]



Please include the following in your
:

Your updated Resume/CV (or LinkedIn profile link).

Your current location (city and country).

Your expected monthly salary (in USD) and availability to start.

In 3-4 sentences, tell us what specific part of this role's scope made you think you're a fit.



Please note: Only
 applications will be considered.

Senior CFMs earn $1,500+ after 6–12 months.



Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.



ABOUT US



Young Publisher – 



We are an international digital marketing company working with content creators and online brands. The company has over 85 employees around the world. We've been in the industry since 2019. We're currently serving over 1,000+ high-ticket clients per year.



We provide an 80% done-for-you content and monetization system that helps creators grow, go viral, and turn views into income using short-form content, AI tools, and proven strategies. Our clients are typically beginners or early-stage creators looking to build their brand, gain followers, and generate income online.



We focus on structure, accountability, and long-term growth.

- Full-time position: 7.5 hours daily, Monday-Friday; 37.5 hours a week

- Complete daily End-of-Day (EOD) reports

- Attend daily team meeting (mandatory, 3pm CET)

REQUIREMENTS (MUST-HAVE)



- C1+ English (written), with perfect grammar and clear, professional responses

- Significant experience creating or reviewing short-form content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts

- Organized and detail-oriented

- Reliable internet and a quiet, professional home workspace

- Accountability mindset and deadline commitment

- Long-term commitment, eager to master a workflow and have direct impact on client success



BONUS SKILLS (NOT REQUIRED)



- Experience supporting creators and social media beginners, especially ages 45+

- Familiarity with AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, etc.

- Strong understanding of trends/strategy for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts



WHY JOIN US?



- Monthly Performance Bonuses: Rewarding high-quality feedback, consistent task completion, and strong teamwork.

- Fully Covered Software: Access to all necessary premium tools and software provided.
