title: Social Media Manager & Content Creator
description:
Social Media Manager & AI Content Creator



Remote | Reels, Video Editing, Marketing & Organic Growth



Can you create content that makes the right person stop scrolling, stay interested, and take action?



Élevè Skin & Wellness is hiring a skilled Social Media Manager who can develop the strategy, create the content, manage our channels, and turn audience attention into qualified inquiries and sales opportunities.



We want an audience that has a reason to become customers: people interested in aesthetics, peptides, and wellness, along with businesses and decision-makers who could purchase our corporate memberships. Audience relevance, meaningful engagement, and business results matter here.



ABOUT ÉLEVÈ



Élevè Skin & Wellness combines mobile aesthetics, peptide education and access, and corporate wellness and longevity memberships.



Our corporate membership model considers the entire executive family: leaders, spouses, parents, and parents-in-law. It brings together concierge coordination, sophisticated technologies focused on brain health and memory, advanced wellness and aesthetic services, partnerships with regenerative medicine and stem-cell physicians, and curated retreats.



Your role is to make the value of our services clear, compelling, and relevant to each audience.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



Content Strategy & Marketing



* Build a content strategy and calendar around our offers, customer questions, buying objections, and revenue priorities.

* Create distinct messaging for potential Botox and filler clients, peptide customers, and corporate membership buyers.

* Attract relevant audiences in the locations where our services are available.

* Balance educational content, storytelling, personality, social proof, and promotional content so each piece serves a clear purpose.

* Connect content to an appropriate next step, including exploring a service, visiting our website, purchasing, booking, or making a qualified inquiry.



Content Creation & AI Production



* Create and edit Reels, short-form videos, Stories, carousels, graphics, and captions.

* Develop concepts and scripts, select visuals, edit footage, and deliver polished content ready to publish.

* Use AI tools confidently to generate original images, video, and other creative assets that fit Élevè’s brand.

* Combine AI-generated assets with founder footage, service information, and approved brand materials.

* Edit for attention and clarity through strong pacing, readable subtitles, purposeful transitions, sound, and visual storytelling.

* Adapt content for each platform and audience, including consumer-facing channels and LinkedIn for corporate opportunities.

* Maintain accurate service information and authentic client stories and results.



Hooks, Storytelling & Viewer Retention



You must understand how to earn attention throughout a piece of content.



* Build a specific, worthwhile payoff before writing the opening.

* Create superhooks and disruptive hooks using clear action, concrete bait, and tension.

* Use mini-hooks, rehooks, curiosity, visual changes, and smaller payoffs to sustain attention throughout videos, carousels, and longer captions.

* Deliver on the opening promise with a satisfying final payoff.

* Write content that gives people a genuine reason to react, comment, save, share, or take the next step.

* Study where viewers lose interest and improve the opening, pacing, structure, or message accordingly.



The framework should shape the content while the finished copy sounds natural, human, and unmistakably Élevè.



Channel Management & Improvement



* Manage publishing, scheduling, comments, and routine audience engagement.

* Recognize buying intent and pass qualified inquiries to our sales team with relevant context.

* Test different openings, formats, topics, and calls to action.

* Review performance regularly and use the findings to improve upcoming content.

* Recommend changes based on what attracts potential customers and moves them closer to a purchase.



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE



* Proven experience managing social media and creating content that generated meaningful engagement, qualified inquiries, or sales.

* Strong hands-on skills in short-form video production, Reels editing, copywriting, and visual storytelling.

* Demonstrated ability to create polished AI-generated content. You must be able to show examples and explain your production process.

* Practical understanding of Alex Hormozi, Russell Brunson, and Gary Vaynerchuk’s approaches to value, offers, storytelling, audience building, and using content to grow a business.

* Strong understanding of superhooks, disruptive hooks, viewer retention, buying psychology, and conversion-focused messaging.

* Ability to translate technical or unfamiliar services into clear, engaging content without exaggerating benefits.

* Excellent written English and a strong feel for natural U.S. audience communication.

* Ability to maintain a premium brand while creating content with personality, humor, and a distinct point of view.

* Strong organization, reliable communication, and the ability to take content from concept through publishing.

* Ability to absorb brand feedback and apply it consistently.



Experience with aesthetics, beauty, wellness, healthcare, or premium service businesses is valuable.



HOW WE WILL MEASURE SUCCESS



We will evaluate the quality of the audience and the business opportunities your work creates, alongside content performance.



Key measures include:



* Growth among relevant potential customers and business buyers.

* Viewer retention, watch time, and completion rates.

* Meaningful comments, shares, saves, and buying questions.

* Relevant profile visits and website traffic.

* Qualified inquiries and leads passed to the sales team.

* Bookings, purchases, and sales attributable to social content where tracking allows.



A smaller, engaged audience of potential buyers can be more valuable to Élevè than thousands of followers with no interest in our services. You should understand how to build both relevance and scale.



COMPENSATION



Compensation will be discussed based on demonstrated skills, experience, and agreed working hours. Include your expected compensation and availability when applying.



HOW TO APPLY



Use the subject line: Élevè Social Media — [Your Name]



Please include:



1. Your résumé and OnlineJobs.ph profile.

2. Links to three relevant content examples, including a Reel and an AI-generated piece. Briefly explain what you personally handled and how you used hooks to hold attention.

3. One account or campaign example showing your results. Include the timeframe, audience, and available engagement, inquiry, or sales data.

4. Your main content creation, AI, editing, and scheduling tools, along with your weekly availability, earliest start date, and expected compensation.



Please share existing work and protect previous clients’ confidential information. We want to understand your creative judgment, your contribution, and the results behind your portfolio.

title: Senior Video Editor & Marketing Implementation Manager
description:
## Read this first



If you're primarily a virtual assistant who also knows some basic editing, this isn't the position for you. We're looking for the person whose portfolio makes us say "holy smokes, this person can edit" — attached to someone who is organized, resourceful, coachable, understands branding, priorities, and treats deadlines as fixed, not aspirational or optional. The boss  is the brain: strategy, campaigns, message, positioning, filming, selling, relationships. This seat is the implementation engine with some collaboration mixed in:  it takes what the boss (and her AI systems) create and gets it all the way across the finish line — edited, on-brand, distributed, verified, done on time. You're not inventing the marketing strategy. You're executing it at a level that makes it look better than the raw material deserved.  Please keep going! 



#1: Video editing (non-negotiable, required day one)



This is the hiring gate. Not "I know CapCut." Not someone who can technically cut clips together. Premiere Pro proficiency required  for long-form: listing films, VSLs, YouTube, interviews, podcasts, complex campaign pieces. CapCut is fine for fast, simple short-form only. You must possess a real command of pacing, storytelling, hooks, B-roll selection, sound design, audio cleanup, color correction, motion graphics, captions, transitions, and retention editing. Have an understanding of how long-form editing differs from short-form. You should be able to coach the boss on production while filming: "your mic is clipping," "leave three seconds before that sentence," "we need B-roll here." There is a real weekly volume expectation: at minimum 15 sub-one-minute shorts, 5 reels, and 1 long-form video (broken down and repurposed) every active campaign week, at professional quality, without falling behind. We are creating several marketing systems in a row so a higher level video editing, posting, repurposing, and retargeting will be a big priority for quite some time. Our marketing IS digital. 







#2: Brand execution + creative judgment



The brand is the box. Creativity happens inside the box. The boss is creating an AI Agent - Branding Bianca - to handle most of the canva type assets, but an understanding of brand guidelines, and logos is important.  You'll be given approved fonts, colors, logos, end cards, thumbnail styles, and a brand guide. We shouldn't have to explain six months in why something doesn't look like it belongs to us. At the same time, we don't want someone who can only duplicate a template — we want someone who looks at the brand and thinks "I understand this visual language, here's a fresh way to execute this idea that's still unmistakably ours." Different campaigns get different creative nuances (more feminine, more fun, more military/veteran, more luxury-editorial) without ever becoming a different brand. You need to be able to work inside that distinction. The Brand look must stay consistent and strong so as not to confuse the viewers. 



#3: Execution discipline (weighted almost as heavily as the editing)



A brilliant editor who can't hit a deadline just produces beautiful unfinished campaigns. We don’t need the staff to be the thing that is slowing the business and the marketing down.  Instructions aren't suggestions. If the process says A → B → C → test → verify → report done, that's what happens.  "Coachable" doesn't mean waiting to be taught every technique. If you're told something isn't good enough yet, you are expected to  ask questions if the explanation is not clear for you, go study strong examples, review what the program says, , figure out the gap, and come back better. Video trainings are available in house for all the marketing systems, tactics and tools that we are to use. Being resourceful is good and expected. Collaboration is good, let’s mastermind on it til we figure it out together, you have your eye and expertise and I have mine.  Ask questions. Immediately, if something is blocking the work. You will never be penalized for asking. You will be penalized for silently guessing and delivering the wrong thing.



#4: Technical capacity and real work infrastructure



This is a professional video-production job, so bring professional infrastructure: A computer that can smoothly edit and export long-form 4K/HD Premiere Pro projects without taking half a day to render. Reliable high-speed internet, plus an actual backup plan (a real second location, not a promise). We will ask for your computer specs (processor, RAM, GPU, storage) and internet speed with your application, and the paid trial will confirm whether the setup actually holds up under real deadlines.





#5: What's handled by prescribed process, not independent judgment



These are execution/SOP skills, not strategy skills. You don't need to arrive as an expert in anything but video editing for business marketing — you need to be technically capable and highly coachable, and you follow our system exactly, not one you learned somewhere else. Content repurposing & distribution:** turning approved long-form source content into the required derivative assets and pushing them to designated platforms, following our prescribed workflow. Paid advertising (Meta):** executing
/Meta campaigns according to our established advertising system — Housing Special Ad Category compliance, audiences, budgets, placements, creative variations, controlled A/B testing (one variable at a time, documented), saving and updating audiences, targeting and retargeting, monitoring, reporting. This is implementation, not independent media strategy. GoHighLevel type CRM: ** funnels, forms, tags, workflows, pipelines, landing pages, automations, troubleshooting. Prior GHL experience is a strong plus but not required — strong technical learning ability is required. The standard for "done" here is specific: built it, tested it, submitted a test lead, confirmed the contact appeared, confirmed the tag fired, confirmed the workflow fired, confirmed the
/text arrived, confirmed Sherri got her notification, updated the task status. That's what DONE means.
 marketing:** building attractive, responsive branded
s and getting bulk sends to actually land — lists/segments, workflow testing, deliverability basics, troubleshooting bounces, reporting. This will be specifically tested; "I can make a pretty
" isn't the bar but style and branding are still important



#6. Who you are



You have a portfolio that proves elite editing, not a résumé that claims it.

Deadline-driven — if I say Friday, it's done Friday. I will be reasonable.  I expect respect on deadlines and quality output. 

You are coachable without being passive, or passive aggressive. You take direction and ask great questions to gain understanding. We are all just here trying to figure it out. 

You are resourceful and attentive.. 

You are organized enough to consistently run a real weekly production schedule on your own and report on it clearly.

You are comfortable with technology generally — workflows, forms, tags, pipelines, bulk
 issues, not afraid to troubleshoot.

Prior real estate marketing experience is a plus, not a requirement.



## To apply



Send: to

2. Premiere Pro experience specifics.

title: VSL/AI Ads Editor
description:
DTC brand doing ~$50k/month in revenue



Role: Video Editor / AI Video Producer Type:



Read this part first



We are not looking for someone to "make our videos look nice."



We are looking for someone who understands that a video's job is to hold attention and make people buy — and who can build that video end to end, including sourcing or generating every frame of footage inside it.



If you need a folder of assets handed to you before you can start editing, this role isn't for you. If you can take a script and a product and come back with a finished, conversion-ready asset, keep reading.



Who we are



We're a direct response DTC brand currently doing around $200k/month, almost entirely on the back of paid media and creative. Creative is our growth lever. Not the site, not the offer tweaks, not the
 flows — the video.



That means the editor seat is one of the highest-leverage roles in the company. When a video wins here, it wins loudly and you'll see it in the numbers within days.



We're scaling, and we want to stop stitching together freelancers per project. We want one highly skilled person who becomes part of the team, learns our angles and our customer inside out, and gets sharper with every batch we ship.



How this role starts (please read carefully)



This does not begin as a full-time position, and that's deliberate.



We start every editor on a lighter workload — a smaller number of videos per week — for the first stretch. Not because we're testing whether you can hold a job, but because we want to see how you fit: how you take feedback, how you handle a script we hand you, how you communicate when something's unclear, and whether the work holds up once the novelty wears off. It also gives you time to learn our customer, our angles, and what a "winning" video looks like in our account specifically.



From there it scales. As the fit proves out and your creatives start performing, the volume goes up, the pay goes up, and the arrangement moves toward a secure, permanent full-time seat — with a defined monthly retainer rather than per-project work.



To be clear about what we're offering:

Phase 1 — Fit: Lower volume, paid per project or at a smaller retainer. Heavy feedback from us. We're both figuring out if this works.

Phase 2 — Ramp: Volume increases, you take on the VSLs and the AI cartoon projects with less hand-holding, pay increases accordingly.

Phase 3 — In-house: Full-time, secure retainer, you own the creative pipeline and have real input on direction. Room to grow into a creative lead as we bring on more editors.



We're not looking for someone to fill a gap for three months. We're looking for the person who's still here in two years running our creative. The slow start is how we get there without either of us wasting the other's time.



If you need immediate full-time income from day one, this probably isn't the right fit right now — and that's fine, just be upfront about it.



What you'll actually be making

1. Long-form VSLs (Video Sales Letters)

-The core of the role. 2–7+ minute sales videos built off scripts we provide.



You'll be responsible for:

-Pacing the entire video so retention doesn't collapse — pattern interrupts, cuts, zooms, motion, sound design, text emphasis, visual proof

-Sourcing your own b-roll. Stock libraries, licensed footage, UGC-style clips, screen recordings, archival, whatever the script calls for. You find it. You don't ask us to send it. In some cases we will also provide clips and we have a bunch of softwares that you can use to make this process easier aswell.

-Generating AI video to fill the gaps stock can't cover — visualizing mechanisms, metaphors, before/after states, scenarios that don't exist as footage.

-Building the visual language for a section, not just laying clips over a voiceover

-Kinetic text, callouts, subtitles, on-screen proof elements, testimonial treatments

-Sound design and music that carries emotional beats without burying the VO



2. AI cartoon / animated videos (short form AND long form)

-We're producing a growing volume of fully AI-generated animated content — story-driven ads, explainer content, character-led narratives.



You'll take a script and:

-Build a consistent character and world (this is the hard part — character consistency across dozens of shots is a real skill and we'll be testing for it)

-Generate the shots yourself using AI image + video tools

-Handle lip sync, voiceover, and audio

-Cut it into a video that actually flows as a story rather than a slideshow of AI clips

-Deliver in both short form (15–60s, vertical) and long form formats



3. Short form paid ads:

-Hook-first ads for Meta / TikTok. High volume, fast iteration. Multiple hook variants of the same body. You'll be cutting these constantly, and you'll be expected to have opinions about which hooks are worth testing.



What we need you to be good at

Non-negotiable:

-Editing that converts, not just editing that looks good. You understand hooks, retention curves, pattern interrupts, why the first 3 seconds determine everything, and how to build toward a CTA. If you've never thought about a video in terms of watch time or CPA, you're not ready for this seat.

-Sourcing your own footage. Independently. You know where to find good b-roll,

-Generating AI video yourself. Not "willing to learn" — actually doing it now. You know how to prompt, how to iterate when a generation is wrong, how to maintain consistency, and how to upscale and clean up output so it doesn't look like AI slop.

-Strong technical craft — clean cuts, deliberate pacing, proper audio levels, colour that matches across mixed sources, subtitles that don't look like an afterthought.

-Speed. We ship a lot. Quality at volume is the whole game.

-Ownership. You get a script and a brief and come back with a finished asset. You flag problems early. You don't go quiet for four days.



Tools — you should be fluent in most of these or their equivalents:

-Editing: Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut.

-AI video: Higgsfield, Veo, Kling, Runway, Sora, Hailuo, Seedance — or whatever you've found works better

-AI image: Midjourney, Flux, Nano Banana, Ideogram

-Voice: ElevenLabs or similar

-Upscaling /cleanup: Topaz, Magnific

-Bonus: Descript, Adobe Podcast, motion graphics templating, basic scripting/automation for batching

-Removing text from video: Vmake



Nice to have:

-You've written or restructured direct response scripts before

-You've worked on offers in health and wellness niche

-You can take a competitor's winning ad, break down why it works, and build a better version

-You track what's new in AI video weekly because you find it genuinely interesting



Who this is NOT for

-Editors who only work from supplied assets

-People who see AI tools as a threat or a gimmick

-"Cinematic" editors who make beautiful videos that don't sell

-Anyone who needs to be chased for updates

-Agencies or people who'll pass the work to a junior. We want the person doing the work.



What you get

-A real seat on a growing team. We start light on purpose, but the destination is a secure full-time role — and if it works, we build our creative operation around you.

-Direct feedback loop on your work. You'll see spend, retention data, and CPA on the creatives you cut. Most editors never get this — it's the fastest way to get genuinely good.

-Budget for tools and subscriptions. We're not going to bottleneck you over a $50/mo AI credit plan.

-Performance bonuses when your creative becomes a winner.

-Room to grow into a creative lead role as we scale and bring on more editors under you.

-Fast decisions. Small team. No layers of approval.



How to apply:

Please follow this exactly — it's the first filter.

-Send your portfolio. We want to see, specifically:

-At least one long-form VSL or long-form sales video you cut

-At least one AI-generated video you produced yourself (cartoon/animated preferred)

-For 2–3 of those videos, tell us in one or two lines each: what the goal was, what you did to hold attention, and any performance numbers you're allowed to share (spend, ROAS, retention, CTR — whatever you have).

-Tell us your AI stack. Which tools you use for what, and one problem you've solved with them that most people get wrong.

-Your rate and your realistic capacity — how many long-form videos and how many short form ads per week.

-Turnaround time on a typical 10-minute VSL, assuming script and VO are provided.

-Confirm you're okay with the ramp-up structure — starting at lower volume and building toward full-time. One line is enough.

title: EXPERIENCED Foreclosure Research & Skip Tracing VA (Real Estate)
description:
EXPERIENCED APPLICANTS ONLY. READ THIS FIRST: We are hiring one experienced Virtual Assistant to research foreclosure and pre-foreclosure filings, skip trace owners and heirs, and manage the resulting leads inside our GoHighLevel (GHL) CRM. This is NOT an entry-level role - we are not training anyone on foreclosure research, skip tracing, or GHL. If you have not personally done this exact work before, please do not apply - your application will be deleted unread.



Part-time to start: roughly 10-15 hours per week at $4/hour, with room to grow for the right person.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Search county websites (clerk of court, recorder of deeds, tax assessor, sheriff sale calendars) and foreclosure attorney / trustee websites to find new foreclosure and pre-foreclosure filings

- Pull the case details: property address, parcel number, case number, sale date, amount owed, lender/plaintiff, and attorney of record

- Skip trace to identify the current owners and, when an owner is deceased, the heirs or estate representatives - using public records, probate filings, obituaries and standard skip tracing tools

- Build and manage clean, organized leads directly inside GoHighLevel (GHL) - pipelines, contact records, tags, and follow-up automations

- Make outbound calls to owners and heirs to introduce us and find out if they are open to selling - friendly and respectful, never pushy

- Log every call and outcome in GHL, and follow up on schedule using GHL workflows

- Work only from publicly available records and follow Do Not Call and standard compliance rules



REQUIRED - YOU MUST ALREADY HAVE

- Proven, hands-on experience pulling foreclosure, pre-foreclosure or probate records from US county websites and attorney / trustee sites. Name the counties and states you have worked.

- Proven, hands-on experience skip tracing owners and heirs. Name the tools you have actually used (for example TruePeopleSearch, BatchSkipTracing, PropStream, REISkip or similar).

- Hands-on working experience with GoHighLevel (GHL) - pipelines, contacts, tags, and workflow automations. Describe exactly what you have built or managed in GHL.

- Real experience calling US homeowners about their property, not just general call center or customer service work

- Strong written and spoken English

- Very detail oriented - accuracy on names, addresses and dates matters a lot here

- Reliable internet, a quiet place to make calls, and able to overlap with US business hours

- Comfortable with Google Sheets / Excel in addition to GHL



PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF

- You have never done foreclosure, probate or distressed property research yourself

- You have never used a skip tracing tool

- You have never used GoHighLevel (GHL) - this role runs on GHL and we are not training on the platform

- You are hoping to learn this on the job or are willing to be trained - we need someone productive from day one

- You are sending a generic copy-paste application



THE INTERVIEW

If we move forward, you must be ready to walk us through your actual work in detail. Be prepared to explain:

- Exactly what you did, step by step - which sites you searched, how you found the filings, and how you ran your skip traces

- Exactly how you have used GHL - which features, for what kind of business, and what results

- What the outcome was - how many leads you pulled, your skip trace hit rate, how many owners or heirs you actually reached, and what came of those calls

- Specific examples - talk us through real cases you worked, including a hard one where the owner was deceased or the heirs were difficult to find, and how you solved it

General answers like "I did research and skip tracing" will end the interview. We want the details and the numbers.



INTERVIEW AVAILABILITY

Interviews can only be scheduled in these windows:

- Monday to Friday: 6:00 PM - 8:00 PM Eastern (6:00 AM - 8:00 AM next day, Philippine time)

- Saturday: 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM Eastern (Saturday 10:00 PM - Sunday 6:00 AM, Philippine time)

- Sunday: 2:00 PM - 4:00 PM Eastern (Monday 2:00 AM - 4:00 AM, Philippine time)

Please only apply if you can make one of these times. In your application, tell us which window works best for you.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your reply with the word FORECLOSURE so we know you read this, then include:

1. The counties and states where you have done foreclosure or probate research, and how long you did it

2. The exact skip tracing and real estate tools you have used

3. Your hands-on experience with GoHighLevel (GHL) - what you built or managed and for how long

4. A sample lead sheet or screenshot of your own past research work (remove any private client information)

5. A short voice recording introducing yourself the way you would on a first call to a homeowner

6. The hours per week you can commit

7. Which interview window above works best for you



Applications that skip these questions will not be reviewed.



To be completely clear: only people who have personally done foreclosure / pre-foreclosure research, skip tracing, AND GoHighLevel work before, and who can prove it with real examples and numbers, should apply. Interest, enthusiasm, related VA experience or a willingness to learn are not enough for this role. If that is not you, please pass on this one - and thank you for reading this far.

title: Video Editor and Social Media Content Creator

We are a UK based B2B digital marketing agency looking for an experienced Video Editor and Social Media Content Creator to join our team.

We want to dramatically increase the amount of video and social content we produce, so we are looking for someone who can work quickly, independently and consistently while maintaining a high creative standard.



The Role



Your main responsibility will be turning raw footage, interviews, podcasts, webinars and existing content into engaging social media content.



You will:



• Edit a high volume of short form videos for LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and other platforms

• Identify the most interesting moments, hooks and stories within raw footage



• Add subtitles, graphics, music, B roll and other elements where appropriate

• Create supporting social graphics and simple visual assets



• Write or adapt captions for social posts



• Schedule and publish content



• Maintain social media content calendars



• Monitor published content and report on reach, engagement, views and other relevant performance metrics



• Identify which content performs best and use this information to improve future content



• Work across several client brands while following their individual styles and brand guidelines



• Use AI tools where they genuinely improve the speed or quality of production



What We Are Looking For



This is not an entry level role.



You must already have professional experience editing video and creating content for social media.



We are particularly interested in people who understand what makes people stop scrolling and watch.



You should understand:



• Strong opening hooks



• Pacing and retention



• Storytelling



• Short form social video



• Subtitles and on screen text



• Sound and music



• B roll selection



• Platform specific formats



• Social media trends



• Repurposing one piece of content into multiple assets



We care about both quality and speed.



We do not want somebody who spends an entire day producing one straightforward social video. We want someone who can develop an efficient production process and produce a substantial volume of good content every week.



Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut or similar professional editing tools is expected.



Experience using modern AI video, editing or content tools is an advantage.



Working Hours



This is a full time position of 40 hours per week.



You must be available Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm UK time.



Please do not apply if you cannot consistently work these hours.



How To Apply



Please do not send us a generic application.



Start your application with the words:



I READ THE FULL JOB DESCRIPTION



Then send us:



1. A short introduction explaining your professional video editing and social media experience.

2. Links to FOUR of the best videos you have personally edited. We want to see work you are genuinely proud of, not a general portfolio containing dozens of examples.

3. A link to ONE piece of content you edited or created that performed particularly well online. Tell us how many views, likes or engagements it received and what you personally did on the project.

4. An example of a social media account or brand you have helped manage, including what you were responsible for.

5. Tell us which video editing software and AI tools you currently use.

6. Tell us approximately how many polished short form videos you believe you could produce during a normal 40 hour working week when supplied with good quality raw footage.

7. Confirm that you can work Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm UK time.



We will shortlist applicants based primarily on the quality of their previous work.



Shortlisted applicants will be given a practical editing task so we can assess creativity, editing quality, speed and ability to follow a brief.



We are looking for somebody who wants a long term role and can become an important part of our content production team.

title: Video Editor | Short Form + Long Form | Premiere Pro
description:
We’re looking for a skilled video editor who can edit both short-form and long-form content.



This is NOT a Canva or template editing position.



You need to be able to take raw footage and turn it into a clean, polished video without needing every cut explained to you.



Our editing style is clean, cinematic, and natural. We do not like excessive transitions, sound effects, graphics, or trendy editing just for the sake of editing.



What matters most is your eye for editing.



You should understand timing, pacing, flow, music, storytelling, and when to make a cut. Whether it’s a 20-second clip or a 15-minute video, it should feel smooth and visually pleasing.



You must be experienced with professional editing software such as:



Adobe Premiere Pro

DaVinci Resolve

Final Cut Pro

Adobe After Effects is a plus



What you’ll edit:



Short-form social media content

Reels and vertical videos

YouTube and long-form videos

Business and educational content

Lifestyle and cinematic content

Talking-head content

Product and brand content



What we DO NOT want:

Canva editing. CapCut templates. Premade templates. Overdone transitions. Random sound effects. Editing that feels busy or cheap.



We want someone who can look at raw footage, understand the direction, and create a strong edit from it.



TO APPLY



Send:



Your portfolio

3 examples of your BEST work

At least one short-form edit

At least one long-form edit

What software you use

How many years you’ve been editing

Your current availability

Put “CLEAN EDIT” in th subject line so I know you read the full post.



Do not send 20 random examples. Send the work that best represents your actual editing ability.



WAGE / SALARY

$800 to $1,200 USD/month depending on experience



Hiring Process

1. Send examples of your best work

2. Free editing test to make sure our styles match

3. 1-week paid trial

4. 4-week paid probation in the full-time position

If all goes well, you’re officially brought on long-term



You must be willing to complete the free test to be considered.

title: AI Video Editor — Short Form (Long Term, Room to Grow)
description:
We make short-form AI videos for health and wellness brands on Facebook and Instagram. You take a script we write, and turn it into a finished video using AI avatars.



What you'll do



Take a written script and a reference video

Create the video using AI tools (avatar, voice, b-roll)

Edit it, add captions, and submit by midnight PHT

Apply feedback so the next batch is better



You'll start with one avatar account (3 videos per day, Monday to Friday). Once you're consistent, you move to two accounts (6 per day). Weekends off.



Pay



$4 per video. At 3 videos a day that's about $260/month. At 6 a day it's about $520/month. Paid on time, every time, no exceptions.



This is a long-term position



We are not looking for someone for one month. My longest editor has been with me for four months and has never had a single complaint about pay, hours, or how they're treated. That's how I run things and it isn't changing.



There is real room to grow here. As we add brands and accounts, the people already on the team get more work and more money before anyone new gets hired. Roles above editing will open up too, and those go to people who are already here.



Who I'm looking for



Hungry. You want to get better, not just get paid.

Consistent. You hit deadlines every day, not most days.

Good instincts. You can look at a video and tell whether it's good, and say why.

Takes feedback well. I give detailed notes. Apply them and you'll move up fast.



Experience with AI video tools is a plus, but instinct and consistency matter more. I'll teach the rest.



How to apply — read this part carefully



Applications with no video attached will not be reviewed. There are two ways to show me your work. Pick either one.



Option A — recreate this video



Watch this video: https://www.instagram.com/reels/Dc15OxSo5Hr/

Recreate it as closely as you can. Same structure, same pacing. Don't copy it exactly — make your version better if you see something you'd improve.

Send the link (Google Drive or Dropbox) and a short note on what you changed and why.



Option B — send work you've already made



If you've already made high quality AI videos in this exact style, skip the test and send those instead. Two or three of your best is enough. The video you submit should be on par with or better than this example video.



You must include proof you actually made them. Any of these works: the project file, the raw export before captions, a screen recording of your timeline, or a link to the account they were posted on. Videos with no proof will not be counted.



With either option, include:



The word BLUEBIRD at the start of your message, so I know you read the whole post

Your discord username — this is where we do all our work and communication

What AI tools you currently have access to, and which ones you don't



I'm hiring fast. I look at every submission personally, and if your work is genuinely good you'll hear from me quickly.

title: VIDEO EDITOR & CONTENT ASSISTANT — LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY
description:
PRIMARY VIDEO-EDITING SKILLS WE NEED



You should be comfortable with as many of the following as possible:



• Applying natural-looking digital makeup and beauty enhancement to faces in video



• Facial and skin retouching while maintaining a realistic, professional appearance



• Correcting complexion, lighting, blemishes and other facial details



• Tracking a moving person's face throughout a video



• Blurring, masking or obscuring specific faces throughout moving footage when privacy is required



• Removing or replacing backgrounds



• Background blurring and cleanup



• Removing unwanted objects or distractions when appropriate



• Color correction and lighting enhancement



• Audio cleanup



• Captions and subtitles



• Editing short-form social content, including Reels, Shorts and similar formats



• Using AI-assisted editing tools to produce professional results quickly and efficiently

Applicants must be at least 18 years of age.



From time to time, projects may involve private, sensitive, health-related, mature or age-restricted subject matter. This can include legitimate educational, wellness, mental-health, maternal/lactation or other material intended for an adult audience.



You must be comfortable handling sensitive material professionally and confidentially.



You must have a private workspace where project content cannot be seen, heard or accessed by children, minors, family members, roommates, visitors or any other unauthorized person.



Whenever project material is displayed on a computer, monitor, television, phone or other device, you are responsible for ensuring that no unauthorized individual can see the screen, hear the material or otherwise access it.



Project materials and information are strictly confidential.

COMPENSATION — PREMIUM RATE FOR LIMITED WEEKLY HOURS



This is an ongoing position with an agreed commitment of approximately 1–4 paid hours per week.



Because the weekly time commitment is intentionally limited, we are willing to pay a higher hourly rate than we normally would for a position offering a larger number of weekly hours.



We are looking for exceptional skill and efficiency—not the lowest hourly rate. If an experienced AI editor can accomplish in one hour what would traditionally require several hours of manual editing, we believe that efficiency has value.



Before beginning work, we will mutually agree upon:



• Your hourly rate

• Your expected weekly hours within the 1–4 hour range

• The responsibilities included in those hours

• How additional work, if requested, will be approved and compensated



There will be opportunities for additional paid hours involving video editing, website content, social-media posting, channel management, comments and engagement. These additional hours are not guaranteed and would be discussed separately.



PERFORMANCE & RECOGNITION BONUSES



In addition to regular compensation, we may occasionally offer fixed performance or recognition bonuses for exceptional work or clearly defined accomplishments.

• Track every application through to outcome: deadlines, follow-ups, results, and what we learn from wins and losses;

title: Google Ads Manager
description:
If you’re a results-driven Google Ads Manager and want to make an impact with the UK’s leading sales and marketing agency for kitchen businesses, this could be your perfect role.

 

Inspire KBB has been growing steadily, and we’re ready to take our clients’ marketing to the next level. As a forward-thinking agency, we offer print, digital, and web solutions tailored to local kitchen retailers across the UK.

 

We’re seeking a talented and experienced Google Ads Manager to strategise, execute, and optimise Google Ads campaigns for local kitchen retailers in the UK.

 

The successful candidate will work in a small, dynamic team where you can make a real impact. You’ll collaborate closely with the Digital Marketing Manager in the UK and other key members to align campaigns with client goals and ensure seamless communication. (We have other employees from the Philippines in the company.)



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Plan, build, and manage Google Ads campaigns across multiple client accounts, each with distinct goals, budgets, and audiences



• Develop and refine campaign structures, audience strategies, and creative briefs based on performance data



• Monitor and analyse performance daily/weekly, making proactive adjustments to improve lead quality and ROI - not just volume



• Produce clear, insight-led reports for internal review and client-facing use, translating data into plain-English recommendations



• Manage advertising budgets responsibly, with strong attention to pacing, allocation, and wastage



• Contribute to the development and documentation of our agency’s Google Ads SOPs - helping to standardise what works across the portfolio



• Join daily Zoom calls with the UK team and maintain clear written communication throughout



TECHNICAL SKILLS REQUIRED

• Google Ads: Hands-on experience managing Search, Performance Max, and ideally Demand Gen campaigns. Comfortable using Google Ads Editor for bulk changes and managing accounts at scale. Experience with Smart Bidding strategies and an understanding of when and why to use them.



• Tracking & Analytics: GA4 for campaign performance analysis. Solid understanding of conversion tracking setup, UTM parameters, and cross-platform attribution. Ability to identify tracking gaps and flag them.



• Automation & Reporting: Familiarity with automation tools such as Zapier or N8N. Ability to use API or MCP connections to pull data and generate reports or workflow automations. This doesn’t need to be at the developer level, but you should be comfortable working with these tools in practice.



• CRO Awareness: An understanding of the full journey from ad to conversion - able to identify whether underperformance sits in the ad, the landing page, or the offer, and brief accordingly.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

• Graduate-level education (or equivalent) in marketing, advertising, or a related field, with a strong foundation in digital advertising and analytics

• Knowledge of organic principles to complement paid campaigns

• Certification in Google Ads

• Familiarity with CRM tools and
 marketing platforms

• Experience in a marketing agency or with multi-client projects



IDEAL ATTRIBUTES

• High attention to detail, ensuring accurate and high-quality work

• Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple projects effectively

• Ability to work methodically and apply the same standards across multiple clients

• Task-focused attitude, with the drive to complete projects efficiently

• High level of written and spoken English

• Willing and able to attend daily Zoom calls

• Strong & reliable broadband connection, with a backup connection ideally available.

• Home working environment is professional, without distractions

• Appreciation for interior design is a bonus



WHY JOIN US?

• Part-time: Up to 20 hours/week (afternoon/early evening PH time)

• Competitive salary: $15-20 per hour, based on skills and experience

• Opportunity to learn and grow within a forward-thinking agency



HOW TO APPLY

• Submit a 150+ word cover note on why you’re a good fit for this role and why it interests you. Include a link to your CV.



RECRUITMENT SCHEDULE

• Applications close – 14th September

• Video interviews conducted on Zoom – week commencing 14th September

• Role commences – Late September/Early October

title: Experienced Video Editor for YouTube & Short-Form Videos
description:
I’m looking for an experienced, detail-oriented Video Editor to help me create polished YouTube videos and short-form content for writers.



I’m a literary agent and writing educator, and I create practical writing advice for authors. I’m looking for someone who can take professionally recorded footage and turn it into clean, engaging, polished videos for YouTube and TikTok.



This is NOT a beginner editing position.



I’m looking for someone with a higher level of experience and visual judgment. The biggest thing I need is someone who can see problems without being told about them.



For example:

• You notice when text is difficult to read against the background and fix it.

• You catch awkward cuts, timing issues, or distracting transitions.

• You recognize when an on-screen graphic doesn’t look right.

• You know how to select complimentary background music and adjust the volume so that the music isn’t competing with me.

• You understand when text should appear, disappear, move, or change.

• You can make good decisions about pacing without needing every edit specified.

• You review your work carefully before sending it to me.

• You don’t repeatedly make the same mistake after receiving feedback.

• You understand that “technically edited” isn’t the same as “professionally finished.”



I want someone who can take ownership of the edit—not someone who waits for me to identify every problem.



What you’ll be editing

Primarily:

• YouTube videos, approximately 8–20 minutes

• YouTube Shorts

• TikTok videos

• Talking-head educational content 

• Writing/craft education content (online writing classes)

• On-screen text, examples, graphics, B-roll, screenshots, music, and occasional visual effects



The content is educational rather than entertainment-focused, so clarity, pacing, and professionalism are more important than flashy effects.



What I’m looking for

You should have:

• 3+ years of professional video editing experience (working on someone else’s videos, not your own)

• Strong experience editing talking-head YouTube content

• Experience creating short-form videos for social media

• Excellent sense of pacing and timing

• Strong typography and visual-design instincts

• Good understanding of text placement, contrast, readability, and composition

• Ability to use B-roll and graphics strategically rather than just adding them for the sake of adding them

• Excellent attention to detail

• Ability to follow a brand/style guide

• Ability to work independently

• Strong English comprehension

• Excellent communication skills

• A willingness to take feedback and apply it consistently



The most important quality

You have good judgment.

I don’t want to have to say: “The text is too dark against the background.” I want you to see that before I do.



I don’t want to point out the same editing issue three times. I want you to understand the feedback, remember it, and apply it to future videos.



You should be the kind of editor who watches the finished video and thinks: “Would I be happy to put my name on this?”



Software

You should be highly proficient in your primary editing software. Please tell me which software you use and how long you’ve been using it.

Experience with CapCut, Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, After Effects, Canva, or similar tools is a plus.



To apply

Please include:

1. A link to your portfolio

2. 2–3 examples of YouTube talking-head videos you’ve edited for someone else

3. 2–3 examples of short-form videos you’ve edited for someone else

4. How many years you’ve been professionally editing

5. What editing software you use

6. Your hourly rate 

7. Your typical turnaround time for a 10–15 minute YouTube video

8. Your availability and approximate number of hours you can work per week

9. A brief explanation of how you make sure you catch visual or editing problems before delivering a video



Please do not send a generic application. Tell me specifically about your experience editing talking-head educational content and what you do to ensure a finished video is polished and professional.



I’m looking for a long-term editor who can become familiar with my content, style, and expectations and eventually require very little hand-holding.



If you were stranded on an island and could only have three things, what would they be?



If you’re highly experienced, detail-oriented, visually aware, and take pride in catching the little things, I’d love to see your work.

A few things we'd love you to do, in order.

2. Record a 5-minute video answering the questions below. No script needed. We just want to get a feel for how you think.

- What did you do for them?

- What was the outcome? Where were they when you started, and where are they now?

- If you have current clients, where are those accounts today?



We're trying to understand how you measure your own impact. The more specific, the better.



5. Quick confirmation that you can work somewhere inside the hours described above.



How You Use AI



In your video, spend a minute or so on this. The more specific the better.



- Which AI tools you use daily, weekly, and occasionally

- A specific example of a task in Google Ads where AI saves you real time, and how you use it

- A time AI gave you a wrong or bad output. How you caught it, and what you did about it

- Anything you've intentionally chosen NOT to let AI do in your work, and why



We're looking for real, lived examples. The specifics tell the story.



A Few Questions for Your Video



Take these in order, and just talk through them naturally.



1. If you took over a Google Ads account on day one for an ecommerce or lead gen client, walk us through what you'd want to look at in your first week and what your first hypothesis to test would be.



2. Walk us through how you'd diagnose a Search campaign that's spending well but not converting. What do you check, in what order, and why?



3. Tell us about a time you disagreed with a client or stakeholder about how a Google Ads account should be structured. What did you push back on, how did you handle it, and what happened?



4. Why do you love this work? Tell us about a recent campaign or 
nt that reminded you why you do it.



5. What's changed about how you structure and signal Google Ads campaigns in the last 12 months (PMax asset groups, search themes, AI Max for Search, broad match plus smart bidding, whatever you've adjusted to)? What's working for you right now and what isn't?

title: SHORT-TERM RENTAL (STR) OPERATIONS MANAGER
description:
We are looking for an experienced, highly organized, and proactive Short-Term Rental Operations Manager to oversee the day-to-day operations of our growing vacation rental business.



This is a management and ownership role, not simply an administrative or guest messaging position.



You will be responsible for making sure our properties, guests, cleaners, maintenance vendors, and internal team are all operating smoothly. You will identify problems before they become bigger issues, create better systems and processes, and make sure tasks are completed properly and on time.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



🏠 PROPERTY OPERATIONS

* Oversee daily operations across multiple short-term rental properties

* Monitor reservations, check-ins, check-outs, and turnovers

* Ensure every property is properly prepared before guest arrival

* Monitor cleaning quality and turnover performance

* Coordinate maintenance, repairs, inspections, and property issues

* Track recurring property maintenance and operational needs

* Identify operational issues and ensure they are resolved promptly

* Maintain property standards and operational checklists



👥 TEAM & VENDOR MANAGEMENT

* Approve pricing when appropriate

* Follow up on incomplete or delayed work

* Manage the STR VA/team and make sure responsibilities are clearly assigned and completed



💬 GUEST EXPERIENCE

* Oversee guest communication and ensure timely responses

* Monitor guest issues, complaints, and special requests

* Make sure the team handles guest concerns professionally and efficiently

* Step in to resolve escalated or urgent guest issues

* Review guest feedback and identify opportunities to improve the guest experience

* Help maintain strong ratings and reviews across booking platforms



📊 OPERATIONS & QUALITY CONTROL

* Create, maintain, and improve SOPs and operational processes

* Develop checklists and systems to reduce mistakes

* Monitor KPIs and team performance

* Conduct regular quality checks

* Track recurring problems and identify their root causes

* Implement solutions to improve efficiency and reduce operational costs

* Ensure important tasks are documented and followed through

* Continuously look for ways to automate or streamline operations



💰 COST & VENDOR MANAGEMENT

* Monitor operational expenses

* Review cleaning and maintenance invoices

* Help control unnecessary property expenses

* Compare vendor pricing and identify cost-saving opportunities

* Maintain organized records of vendor information and expenses



👤 OWNER SUPPORT

* Assist with owner requests and property-related concerns

* Provide regular updates on property operations

* Coordinate owner stays and special requests

* Communicate maintenance, repair, and operational updates clearly

* Help ensure owners have confidence that their properties are being properly managed



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



The ideal candidate is someone who takes ownership and gets things done.



You should be:

* Highly organized and extremely detail-oriented

* Proactive rather than reactive

* A strong problem solver

* Comfortable managing multiple properties and priorities

* Excellent at written and verbal English communication

* Confident communicating with guests, owners, employees, and vendors

* Comfortable managing people and holding team members accountable

* Resourceful and able to research solutions independently

* Good at following up and making sure tasks are actually completed

* Comfortable working with deadlines and time-sensitive situations

* Able to stay calm when unexpected problems happen

* Tech-savvy and comfortable learning new software

* Able to create structure and processes in a growing business



STR EXPERIENCE IS STRONGLY PREFERRED

- Previous experience managing Airbnb, Vrbo, vacation rentals, or short-term rental operations is strongly preferred.



Experience with platforms such as:

* Airbnb

* Vrbo

* Hospitable

* Turno

* Google Workspace

* Slack

* Notion

* Other property management or task management systems



is a major plus.



### THIS ROLE REQUIRES OWNERSHIP



We are not looking for someone who simply waits for instructions.



If you see a problem, **you own the problem until it is resolved.**



For example:

> A property is scheduled to check in at 3 PM. At 10 AM, the cleaner reports that there is a plumbing issue and the property may not be ready.



We expect you to immediately assess the situation, coordinate with maintenance, determine the expected timeline, communicate with the appropriate people, arrange alternatives if necessary, update the guest/team, and make sure the issue is fully resolved.



You should be someone who thinks:

“What needs to happen next, and who needs to handle it?”

—not someone who waits to be told what to do.



HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS



Success in this role means:



* Properties are consistently guest-ready

* Turnovers happen smoothly and on schedule

* Guest issues are handled quickly

* Vendors are reliable and held accountable

* Team members complete their responsibilities

* Problems are identified before they become emergencies

* SOPs and systems continuously improve

* Operational costs are controlled

* Owners receive timely and accurate updates

* The business can grow without operations becoming chaotic



WORKING HOURS - US hours but specific schedule will be discussed during the interview. Because short-term rental operations are time-sensitive, you must be available to handle urgent operational issues during scheduled working hours.



TO APPLY



Please send us:

1. Your resume or work history

2. A brief description of your **STR/property management experience**

3. Number of properties you have previously managed

4. Platforms/software you have experience using

5. Your experience managing employees, VAs, cleaners, or vendors

6. Your preferred hourly rate

7. Your availability and preferred working hours

8. Short intro video



Please also answer the following:

- A property has a 3 PM check-in. At 11 AM, the cleaner tells you they cannot complete the turnover, and the next available cleaner says they can only arrive at 2 PM. What steps would you take to make sure the property is ready for the guest?

title: Guest Services / Customer Support
description:
About the Role 







Reports to: Founder 







Our client is an established short-term rental property management company managing approximately 30 homes and 34 listings in its local market. The company has been in business for five years and handled thousands of bookings last year. With direct bookings increasing by approximately 30% year over year and continued investment in its website and guest experience, the business is continuing to grow. 







 We're looking for a Guest Services / Customer Support representative who can become a reliable extension of the team—an A-player who can take ownership of day-to-day guest communication, monitor incoming calls and messages, and help ensure operational issues are identified and addressed before they become larger problems. 







 This role is primarily focused on guest services and communication. You'll monitor the phones, Airbnb/VRBO messages,
, and Breezeway tasks, helping the team stay ahead of guest needs and operational issues. The goal is not simply to respond to messages, but to provide the kind of warm, natural, thoughtful communication that reflects the level of service our client wants its guests to receive. 







 The company has invested heavily in documenting its properties and building a centralized repository of property information, including videos, photos, appliance information, and other details. This gives the right person the resources needed to learn the homes and quickly find accurate answers rather than relying on the local team for every question. 







 The company is also incorporating AI into its guest communication workflows. The AI currently provides suggested responses that the team can review, approve, or revise. The Guest Services / Customer Support will bring the human judgment required to audit these responses, recognize when something doesn't sound right, and make sure communication remains natural and appropriate for the guest. 







 This is not a basic administrative VA role. We're looking for someone who understands short-term rental operations, communicates confidently with guests, and can use good judgment without needing constant direction. The ideal candidate will be comfortable stepping into a busy environment, learning the property portfolio, and becoming a dependable resource for the team. 







 As the business continues to grow, there is potential for this to become a long-term position with additional responsibilities and the opportunity to support the future Assistant Manager / Operations Manager. 



  



What You’ll Own 



 Guest Services & Communication (Primary Focus) 



• Guest Communication: Monitor and respond to guest inquiries through Airbnb/VRBO messaging,
, and other communication channels. 



• Phone Coverage: Monitor incoming calls through RingCentral and confidently communicate with guests by phone. 



• Responsiveness: Maintain a response time of approximately 20 minutes or less during assigned working hours. 



• Guest Experience: Provide warm, natural, patient, and thoughtful communication rather than short or transactional responses. 



• Problem Resolution: Use available property information and resources to answer guest questions and resolve routine issues independently. 



• Escalation: Recognize situations that require the local team's attention and escalate appropriately, particularly when an issue is urgent or could impact the guest experience. 



 



 Breezeway & Property Operations Support 



 • Task Monitoring: Monitor Breezeway tasks alongside incoming guest communication and identify items that may require attention. 



• Issue Identification: Review tasks and updates, recognize where there may be an operational issue, and flag it before it becomes a larger problem. 



• Updates: Keep relevant information and task statuses updated in the appropriate systems. 



• Property Knowledge: Become familiar with the company's homes, amenities, appliances, and property-specific information so that guest questions can be answered accurately. 



 



 AI & Technology Support 



 • AI Response Review: Review AI-generated guest responses and determine whether they are appropriate before they are sent. 



• Human Judgment: Recognize when an AI response doesn't sound natural, has an issue with syntax, doesn't make sense, or fails to address the guest's actual situation. 



• System Navigation: Work confidently across the company's technology platforms and quickly learn new tools. 



• Knowledge Base: Use the Prohost Guidebook database and other internal resources to find the information needed to assist guests. 



  



Administrative & Property Support 



 • Property Setup: Assist with property onboarding and setup tasks as needed, including uploading photos, descriptions, and other property information. 



• Administrative Support: Assist with other recurring administrative or operational tasks when guest-service volume allows. 



• Content Support: Support basic social media or other marketing-related tasks when appropriate. 



• Documentation: Help keep property information and operational resources organized and up to date. 



 



 Who This Role Is For  



You may be a strong fit if you:  



• Have STR Experience: You understand short-term rental or vacation rental operations and the pace and expectations that come with guest stays. 



• Are Guest-Focused: You genuinely care about providing an excellent guest experience and understand the importance of making guests feel heard and valued. 



• Communicate Naturally: You have excellent spoken and written English and can communicate with guests in a warm, conversational, professional way. 



• Are Comfortable on the Phone: Speaking with guests by phone is second nature to you. You can confidently answer questions, handle unexpected situations, and communicate professionally. 



• Have Strong Judgment: You know when to handle an issue yourself, when to investigate further, and when something needs to be escalated. 



• Operate with Urgency: You understand that guest communication and operational issues are time-sensitive and should not sit unattended. 



• Are Proactive: You don't simply wait for someone to tell you what to do. You monitor what is happening, identify potential issues, and take appropriate action. 



• Are Self-Directed: You can use available resources, search for answers, and work through problems independently rather than immediately relying on the founder or assistant manager. 



• Are AI-Fluent: You are comfortable working with AI-assisted communication tools and understand that AI-generated responses still require human oversight and judgment. 



• Learn Quickly: You can absorb property-specific information, systems, and processes without becoming overwhelmed. 



• Have a Service Mindset: You understand that great guest communication requires empathy, patience, attention to detail, and good instincts—not simply following a script. 



 



 Preferred Qualifications  



• Hands-on experience in short-term rental, vacation rental, hospitality, or property management. 



• Previous experience handling guest communications for Airbnb, VRBO, or similar platforms. 



• MUST have experience with RingCentral, Slack, Prohost, Sway, OwnerRez, Breezeway, and ClickUp. 



• Experience working with AI-assisted customer service or guest communication tools. 



• Experience supporting multiple properties or a property management portfolio. 



• Experience with property onboarding or setup, including uploading photos, descriptions, and property information. 



• Additional administrative, marketing, or social media experience is a plus. 



  



Compensation & Schedule 



• Hourly Rate: $6–10/hr, based on experience, with openness toward the higher end of the range given the company's immediate need. 



• Priority Coverage: Wednesday–Saturday and Monday approximately 10am–7:00 PM Pacific Time, when guest activity and operational demands are particularly high. 



• Availability: Saturday availability is important, with flexibility around the exact schedule based on business needs. 



• Long-Term Opportunity: While the immediate need is to provide additional guest-service coverage, this is not intended to be a short-term gap-filler. If the right person is successful, there is potential for the role to continue long-term and provide support to the future Assistant Manager.
