title: wordpress webmaster
description:
I’m looking for someone to help me build out and manage a large network of local home service websites.



I need someone who is VERY good with WordPress. You should be completely comfortable setting up, building, managing, and troubleshooting WordPress sites without needing someone to walk you through every step.



Ideally, you’ve worked with a large network of WordPress sites before. If you have experience managing 100+ sites at the same time, that’s a big plus.



The job itself is pretty straightforward.



I will provide the domain names and direction. Your job will be to take those domains and turn them into finished, working WordPress sites.



We’ll eventually be launching several new sites every day, so I need someone who is organized and can build a repeatable process instead of treating every website like a completely new project.



I will provide and pay for all the tools you need. Hosting, WordPress tools, plugins, AI tools, themes, software, etc.



You should always be looking for ways to streamline the process and automate any redundant tasks, so I fully expect to be purchasing additional software and tools based on your recommendations as we get going.



You should be comfortable with things like:



WordPress setup and configuration

Themes and page builders

Plugins

DNS and domains

Hosting

Basic HTML/CSS

Site speed and optimization

SEO basics

Forms and lead generation

Google Analytics/Search Console

Using AI tools to help build sites and content faster

Managing and updating a large number of sites



You don’t need to be an expert developer, but you absolutely need to know your way around WordPress.



We’ll use Slack for day-to-day communication. We’ll also set up a system where every website, domain, login, status, launch date, and other important information is tracked so anyone on the team can see exactly where everything stands.



I care a lot about organization. Once we get moving, there will be a LOT of websites, so keeping everything organized is going to be just as important as building them.



This is not a short-term project. I’m building a pretty large network and I’m looking for someone who can take ownership of this side of it and stay with me long term.



Pay is around $1,000 USD/month to start.



I’m ready to hire immediately.



When you apply, send me:



Your WordPress experience

How many WordPress sites you’ve managed at one time

A few examples of sites you’ve built

What hosting platforms/page builders you know best

What AI tools you currently use

Your current availability

Your expected monthly salary



Also, start your application with the word “LOCAL” so I know you actually read the entire post.

title: Remote Media QC and Delivery Coordinator
description:
PLEASE READ THE ENTIRE JOB POSTING BEFORE APPLYING



There are very specific instructions on how to apply at the end of this posting.



You will NOT be considered if the application instructions are not followed.



Please read the entire posting carefully before submitting your application.



REMOTE MEDIA QC & DELIVERY COORDINATOR



DEPARTMENT: QC / Post-Production



REPORTS TO: CEO & Administrative Team



POSITION: Full-Time, Long-Term



WORK HOURS: Tuesday–Saturday, 6:30 AM–2:30 PM Central Time



STARTING PAY: $8 USD/hour  

                             $7 USD/hour during the 30-day trial period



GROWTH: Opportunities for raises based on initiative, performance and  reliability, as your skills grow and you consistently demonstrate quality, efficiency, independence, strong communication, and the ability to take on additional responsibilities.





ABOUT US

Andrews Media is a family-run real estate media company based in North Alabama. We create high-quality photography, video, drone, floor plans, Zillow 3D Tours, Zillow Showcase, and other marketing content for real estate professionals.



We are known for our fast turnaround, high-quality work, and strong focus on relationships with our clients.



Our team is growing, and we are looking for someone who wants to become a valued, long-term member of our team.

We care about doing great work, treating people well, communicating clearly, and supporting the people we work with.



If you are a positive, detail-oriented person who loves to learn, takes feedback well, takes initiative, and wants to grow with a close-knit and supportive team, we would love to meet you!



ABOUT THE POSITION

We are looking for a Remote Media QC & Delivery Coordinator to manage our daily media quality control and delivery process.

This is an important role within our company. You will be responsible for making sure that the media our clients receive is complete, accurate, high-quality, and delivered correctly and on time.



You will manage projects as they move through our editing process, communicate with our editors and administrative team, review completed work, make basic corrections when needed, and ensure that every item included on a client's order has been completed and delivered.



Our goal is to have the majority of our daily orders fully reviewed and delivered by 11:00 AM, or noon at the latest. Some days will have a larger volume of media and may require additional time. The 2:30 PM end of the workday provides time to complete heavier delivery days, handle revisions, resolve issues, and make sure nothing is left unfinished.



You will begin working at 6:30 AM, preparing files, checking project status, reviewing completed media, communicating with editors, making corrections, and preparing orders for delivery throughout the morning.



This is not a position where you wait until 11:00 AM to begin delivering projects. We need someone actively managing the workflow from the time they start until the day's work is complete.



The ideal candidate is someone who is highly organized, extremely detail-oriented, comfortable working with photo and video, and able to manage multiple projects at the same time without becoming overwhelmed.



You should also be comfortable taking ownership of a project from beginning to end and speaking up when something doesn't look right.



RESPONSIBILITIES:

PROJECT MANAGEMENT

-Manage and keep track of daily orders and deliveries.

-Begin preparing and processing deliveries when your shift starts at 6:30 AM.

-Submit projects to the appropriate editors according to our workflow and deadlines.

-Monitor projects throughout the editing process.

-Follow up with editors regarding project status and outstanding work.

-Monitor completed projects and make sure they are ready for delivery.

-Identify missing or incomplete items and make sure they are corrected.

-Communicate with our administrative team regarding project status and delivery issues.

-Flag urgent or complex issues to the appropriate team member and ensure timely follow-up.

-Manage multiple projects and priorities at the same time.

-Work toward having the majority of daily orders fully QC'd and delivered by 11:00 AM, or noon at the latest.

-Continue working through the remainder of the day to complete heavier-volume orders, revisions, corrections, and any outstanding issues.

-Help ensure that all daily deliveries are completed accurately and on time.



PHOTO QUALITY CONTROL

You will carefully review completed photo edits before they are delivered to our clients.

This includes checking for:

-Missing photos

-Incorrect or incomplete edits

-Crooked photos or incorrect verticals

-Exposure and brightness issues

-Incorrect color or white balance

-HDR/blending issues

-Editing mistakes or artifacts

-Poor masking

-Objects that should have been removed

-Inconsistent editing throughout a property

-Other issues that do not meet Andrews Media's quality standards



When appropriate, you will make basic corrections yourself using Photoshop or Lightroom.

If an issue requires the editor's attention, you will communicate the issue clearly and send it back to the appropriate editor for correction.



PHOTOSHOP & LIGHTROOM

Proficiency in both Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Lightroom is an ABSOLUTE REQUIREMENT for this position.

You must have current access to both programs and be comfortable using them professionally.

-Photoshop must include Generative Fill.

-You should be comfortable making basic photo corrections such as:

-Removing unwanted objects

-Basic retouching

-Straightening photos

-Correcting minor exposure issues

-Making basic color adjustments

-Cleaning up minor editing issues

-Other simple corrections that can be completed efficiently

-You should also be able to recognize when something is beyond a simple correction and needs to be returned to the editor.



VIDEO QUALITY CONTROL

Our video editors handle the majority of our video editing, but you will be responsible for reviewing completed videos before they are delivered to clients.

You will check videos for:

-Missing footage

-Missing or incorrect clips

-Obvious editing mistakes

-Incorrect property information

-Audio issues

-Visual errors

-Timing or transition problems

-Formatting or export issues

-Other errors that would prevent the video from being client-ready

-If a video needs changes, you will communicate the necessary corrections to the video editor and make sure the changes are completed.

-After changes are made, you will review the video again before it is delivered.



You do not need to be an advanced video editor, but you must have enough knowledge of video editing to recognize common issues and communicate clearly with our video editors.



OTHER MEDIA QUALITY CONTROL & DELIVERY

You will also be responsible for reviewing and delivering other products included in our clients' orders, including:

-Floor plans

-Zillow 3D Tours

-Zillow Showcase

-Other media products included on an order



For every order, you will verify that everything the client ordered has been completed, reviewed, and delivered.

You are responsible for making sure that nothing is a
 left out.



COMMUNICATION & TEAMWORK

You will communicate regularly with:

-Company leadership

-Administrative team

-Photo editors

-Video editors

-Other production team members



Good communication is extremely important in this position.

If you see a problem, we want you to speak up.



If something is missing, incorrect, late, or doesn't look right, you should communicate the issue rather than allowing it to reach the client.



You will need to be comfortable asking questions, following up with people, and keeping the appropriate team members informed.



We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their work rather than waiting to be told what to do.



SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

REQUIRED

-Excellent written and spoken English

-Extreme attention to detail

-Ability to manage several tasks and projects at once

-Ability to work quickly while maintaining accuracy

-Strong organizational skills

-Ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines

-Ability to work independently

-Ability to communicate promptly during working hours

-Ability to take feedback well

-Fast learner and willing to learn new systems and processes

-Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop

-Proficiency in Adobe Lightroom

-Current access to Photoshop with Generative Fill

-Basic knowledge of video editing and video quality control

-Reliable computer capable of handling large photo and video files

-High-speed, reliable internet

-Ability to work Tuesday–Saturday, 6:30 AM–2:30 PM Central Time



PREFERRED

-Previous real estate photography or real estate media experience

-Previous photo QC experience

-Previous video QC experience

-Experience working with professional photographers or video editors

-Experience with Canva

-Experience with Slack

-Experience with CRM software

-Experience with Google Workspace / G Suite

-Experience with Final Cut Pro

-Experience with CapCut

-Experience working for U.S. or other international employers



INTERNET & COMPUTER REQUIREMENTS — ABSOLUTE REQUIREMENT

This position requires high-speed, reliable internet.

A large portion of this job involves downloading and uploading large photo and video files.

In order to meet our daily deadlines, these uploads and downloads need to happen quickly.



You must have:

-Your own reliable computer

-Your own high-speed internet connection

-A reliable working environment

-The ability to consistently upload and download large files without significant delays



Please be honest about your internet speed and reliability.



If, during our training or trial period, we determine that your internet connection is not reliable or fast enough to meet our workflow and daily deadlines, we will not be able to continue employment.



30-DAY TRIAL PERIOD

All new hires will begin with a 30-day trial period.

During this period, we will provide training on our systems, processes, quality standards, and workflow while evaluating your ability to perform the responsibilities of the position.

Tuesday–Saturday

Dependable

Responsible

Detail-oriented

Organized

Proactive

A strong communicator

A quick learner

Comfortable receiving feedback

Comfortable asking questions

Able to manage multiple priorities

Someone who takes ownership

Someone who genuinely wants to become part of a team

When would you be available to start?

PART 2 — VIDEO APPLICATION

IMPORTANT VIDEO INSTRUCTIONS:

Please answer each question separately.

ONE LAST THING

We intentionally provide detailed instructions because this position requires someone who can pay attention to details, follow processes, communicate clearly, and take initiative.



Following the application instructions carefully is the first opportunity to show us that you have those qualities.

We look forward to hearing from you!



— The Andrews Media Team

title: Short-Form UGC Video Editor for DTC Ecom Ads (USA TikTok Shop + AI Clip Sourcing)
description:
We run direct-to-consumer ecommerce brands and we need a short-form video editor who can turn a script into a finished, ready-to-run ad.



Here's the good news for you: we already do the hard part. For every single video you get a full production doc — the word-for-word voiceover script and a shot-by-shot table that tells you exactly what clip goes in every scene, complete with search terms. You're not guessing or writing anything. Your job is to source those clips, cut them together to our spec, add the AI voiceover and captions, and hand back an ad that stops the scroll and sells.



What you'll be doing:

- Take our production doc (full VO + scene-by-scene clip breakdown) and build the video

- Source matching clips from USA TikTok Shop — this is the core skill, you have to know how to find and pull the right footage and match a casting brief

- When a scene can't be found on TikTok, generate the clip yourself with an AI video tool (Higgsfield, or whatever you're best with) so no scene ever gets skipped or compromised

- Assemble to spec, add AI voiceover (ElevenLabs) and clean synced captions

- Deliver 9:16 
 ready to run on
 and Instagram



The style — read this so you know if it's you:

- Vertical 9:16, roughly 25–50 seconds

- Voiceover only, no background music

- Fast cuts — a new clip every 2–4 seconds, zero dead air

- The product/hook lands in the first 3 seconds

- The full voiceover shown on screen as bold, synced captions

- Native "filmed on a phone" UGC feel — not a polished, glossy commercial. AI-generated clips need to match that same raw look and blend in seamlessly with the real footage



Basically, the kind of ad that looks organic in the feed and still sells hard.



Must-haves:

- Proven experience editing short-form direct-response / UGC ads (send examples)

- You know how to source clips from USA TikTok Shop and match a subject/casting brief

- You can generate AI video clips (Higgsfield or similar) to fill gaps when the right footage doesn't exist — and make them look native, not obviously AI

- Fast turnaround, can handle volume — we build in batches of 9+ at a time

- You can follow an SOP exactly, without hand-holding

- Solid with CapCut or Premiere, ElevenLabs voiceover, and caption timing

- Reliable, communicative, hits deadlines



Nice to have:

- You'
 edited or run winning
 / TikTok ads before

- You actually get direct-response — you know why the first 3 seconds d
 everything



The details:

- Ongoing and long-term. New batches come regularly, so this is steady work for the right person.

- Pay is per finished video — tell us your rate.

- We start with one paid test video $6 per hour . We give you the doc, you deliver one ad, and if it's good we roll straight into volume.



How to apply:

1. Start your reply with the word *MIST* so we know you actually read this. Applications without it get ignored.

2. Send 2–3 examples of short-form vertical ads you've edited (UGC / DR style, ideally with sourced clips + voiceover + captions). If any of them use AI-generated clips, point them out.

3. In one or two lines: how do you source clips from USA TikTok Shop, which AI video tool you use when a clip doesn't exist, and how long you'd need to turn around a single 40-second ad.

title: Amazon Online Arbitrage Product Sourcer PART TIME
description:
We are a growing, family-owned Amazon business seeking an experienced Online Arbitrage Product Sourcer for a part-time position.

Our company is built around faith, family, discipline, integrity, and teamwork. We are building this business carefully and intentionally, and we are looking for someone who wants to grow alongside us – not someone searching for a short-term position or working for several Amazon sellers at once.

The right person will be dependable, honest, detail-oriented, and able to work independently while consistently meeting established sourcing standards.



SCHEDULE AND COMPENSATION

• Part-time position

• 5 working hours per day

• 25 working hours per week 

• Starting pay: $3.00 USD per hour.

• Schedule: Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m.–2:30 p.m. Philippine Time, with a 30-minute unpaid lunch break. This position requires 5 working hours per day and 25 hours per week.  

• Growth opportunities: Successful team members may become eligible for performance-based bonuses, raises, and advancement into senior sourcing, quality-control, training, or team-lead roles.

• Performance reviews: Compensation and performance will be formally reviewed after 90 days. Future raises and advancement will be based on lead quality, productivity, reliability, communication, length of service, and the company’s needs.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Your primary responsibility will be finding profitable online-arbitrage products that meet our company’s purchasing criteria.

Your daily work may include:

• Using proven sourcing strategies to find products

• Researching profitable products from approved online retailers 

• Evaluating products using applicable tools 

• Reviewing sales rank, estimated sales, price history, Buy Box history, offer count, Amazon presence, variation data, and competition 

• Verifying that products are exact matches between the retailer and Amazon listing 

• Checking product size, quantity, model, color, variation, UPC, and other identifying details 

• Identifying possible restrictions, intellectual-property risks, hazmat issues, meltable products, and other concerns 

• Calculating ROI and estimated profit accurately 

• Recording all qualified leads in the company’s designated sourcing spreadsheet 

• Communicating questions, concerns, and sourcing obstacles promptly 

• Protecting all company information, sourcing methods, and product leads 



END-OF-SHIFT EXPECTATIONS

At the end of every shift, you will be expected to:

• Submit at least 2 qualified leads 

• Ensure every required field in the sourcing spreadsheet is complete and accurate 

• Verify each lead against the company’s current sourcing criteria 

• Provide a brief end-of-shift report 

• Report the number of leads found, websites searched, strategies used, and any challenges encountered 

• Clearly identify any lead that requires additional review 

• Confirm that all submitted work is original and has not been shared with another seller 

Consistent quality is more important than filling the spreadsheet with products that do not meet our criteria. However, both quality and daily productivity will be measured.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Applicants must have previous experience sourcing products for an Amazon Online Arbitrage business. This is not an entry-level sourcing position, and we are not currently accepting applicants who require complete training from the beginning.

Qualified applicants should have:

• Previous experience as an Amazon Online Arbitrage Product Sourcer 

• Working knowledge of SellerAmp SAS and Keepa 

• Experience evaluating profitability, ROI, estimated sales, price history, and competition 

• Familiarity with Amazon fees, Buy Box behavior, sales rank, variations, and offer counts 

• Experience using spreadsheets accurately 

• Strong written English communication 

• Reliable internet access and a dependable computer 

• Excellent attention to detail 

• The ability to follow written instructions precisely 

• The ability to work independently and meet daily expectations 

• A strong record of honesty, confidentiality, and reliability 

Experience with Amazon Seller Central is preferred, not required.



CONFIDENTIALITY AND LEAD SHARING

All products, leads, retailer information, sourcing methods, spreadsheets, account information, and other business materials provided or discovered during this position are confidential.

Your sourcing activity and submitted leads will be monitored and reviewed through SellerAmp and other company systems. Leads found for our company may not be shared, sold, reused, or submitted to another Amazon seller.

Applicants must understand that unauthorized lead sharing is a serious breach of trust and company policy. Confirmed violations may result in immediate termination and may be reported to OnlineJobs.ph in accordance with the platform’s policies.



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

To be considered, please follow all of the instructions below:

1. Use the subject line: “Amazon Sourcer 001” 

2. Briefly describe your previous Amazon Online Arbitrage sourcing experience. 

3. List the sourcing strategies you have personally used. Do not simply provide a general list – briefly explain which strategies you have used and how you used them. 

4. List the sourcing and research tools you have experience using. 

5. Tell us approximately how many qualified leads you were expected to submit during an eight-hour shift in your previous role. 

6. Include your current availability and preferred working hours. 

7. Copy and include the following statement in your application: 

“I understand that my sourcing activity and submitted leads may be tracked and reviewed through SellerAmp and other company systems. I agree that I will not share, sell, reuse, or submit the company’s leads to another Amazon seller. I understand that confirmed lead sharing may result in immediate termination and a report to OnlineJobs.ph.”

** Applications that do not contain the correct subject line, sourcing strategies, and confidentiality statement will not be considered.



CAREER GROWTH

The starting rate for this position is $3.00 USD per hour, with the opportunity to earn additional performance-based bonuses.

We want to build a dependable team and retain excellent people for the long term. Team members who consistently produce high-quality work, communicate well, protect company information, and demonstrate reliability may receive regular raises and increased responsibilities.

As the business grows, advancement opportunities may include:

• Full-Time

• Senior Product Sourcer 

• Lead Reviewer or Quality-Control Specialist 

• Sourcer Trainer 

• Sourcing Team Lead 

• Additional Amazon operations or management responsibilities 

We are looking for someone who wants to become a trusted member of our company and grow with us.

title: Short-Form Content & Social Media Coordinator
description:
Short-Form Content & Social Media Coordinator



The Authentic Journey is looking for a creative, reliable content creator to help turn our long-form podcast and video content into engaging short form content and manage the distribution of that content across social media.



We're ideally looking for one person who can both edit short-form videos and manage social media posting, but we're open to candidates who specialize in one area.



What You'll Be Doing



Short-Form Content

-Review podcast and long-form video episodes to identify strong moments, stories, hooks, and insights.

-Edit clips into engaging 30–90 second vertical videos.

-Create content for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and other social platforms.

-Add captions, graphics, punch-ins, B-roll, music, and other elements when appropriate.

-Create strong opening hooks while maintaining the speaker's original message and voice.

-Repurpose existing long-form content into multiple pieces of short-form content.



Social Media

-Upload and schedule approved content across our social platforms.

-Write captions, titles, descriptions, and basic calls to action.

-Properly format and optimize posts for each platform.

-Maintain a consistent posting schedule.

-Organize content so we know what has been posted, scheduled, and is still in production.

-Help identify which topics and clips are performing well so we can create more of what works.



Who We're Looking For



You should have:

-Experience editing vertical short form video.

-A strong understanding of Reels, Shorts, and TikTok.

-Good instincts for identifying compelling moments from longer conversations.

-Strong attention to detail.

-Good communication and ability to meet deadlines.

-Ability to work independently once the creative direction is established.



Experience with podcasts, personal brands, entrepreneurship, storytelling, motivational content, sports, or interview based content is a plus.



We're less concerned about what editing software you use and more concerned about your storytelling, pacing, judgment, and ability to recognize a great clip.



About The Authentic Journey



The Authentic Journey is a growing content brand centered around stories, experiences, personal growth, and the lessons we can learn from successful and influential people.



We're evolving the brand beyond simply creating a podcast. Our goal is to build a recognizable media platform with consistent, high-quality content across multiple channels.



To Apply



Please send:



-A brief video introduction about yourself. **Instructions Below**

-3–5 examples of short-form videos you've edited.

-Examples of social media accounts you've helped manage, if applicable.

-Which areas you're strongest in: editing, social media management, or both.

-Your typical availability and turnaround time.

-Your rate or preferred compensation structure.



Video Introduction Required



Please submit a 60–90 second video introduction created specifically for this application.



In your video, please answer:

-Introduce yourself and tell us what you specialize in.

-Tell us whether you're stronger in short-form editing, social media management, or both.

-After reviewing The Authentic Journey, tell us one thing you would change or improve about our current short-form/social content and why.

-Tell us what you think makes a podcast clip worth stopping and watching instead of scrolling past.



Important: Please mention The Authentic Journey by name somewhere in your video.



Please do not apply with a generic or pre-recorded introduction video that you send to every job posting. If you're submitting a video introduction, take a moment to tell us why you're interested in The Authentic Journey specifically and what you believe you could bring to the content.



We're looking for someone who actually reads the job description and is interested in becoming part of what we're building, not someone mass applying to editing jobs.



Bonus: Pick one piece of long-form content you've previously worked on and briefly explain how you d
 which moments should become short form clips.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Work ’N Gear is a multi-location U.S. workwear and footwear retailer. We are looking for a highly capable accountant who can both own day-to-day accounting and build the financial infrastructure of the business from the ground up. This is not a basic bookkeeping role. We need someone who understands how transactions flow through a retail business and can design clean, scalable processes across our POS, QuickBooks, banking, accounts payable, inventory, e-commerce, and reporting systems.



Key Responsibilities:

Accounting Infrastructure

- Take ownership of setting up and improving our accounting infrastructure in QuickBooks Online.

- Integrate and properly configure Lightspeed Retail POS with QuickBooks Online, including sales, payment methods, sales tax, inventory-related entries, and register closures.

- Establish a clean chart of accounts and accounting workflows appropriate for a multi-location retail business.

- Build reconciliations, controls, month-end close procedures, and accounting SOPs.

- Identify accounting gaps and proactively recommend better processes rather than simply following existing procedures.



Accounts Payable

- Own the full accounts payable process.

- Enter and categorize vendor bills accurately.

- Maintain vendor balances and payment schedules.

- Reconcile vendor statements and investigate discrepancies.

- Ensure invoices have appropriate documentation and approvals.

- Maintain organized digital accounting records.



General Accounting

- Reconcile POS sales and cash receipts to bank deposits.

- Reconcile payment processors and e-commerce activity.

- Maintain accurate accruals, prepaid expenses, fixed assets, and other balance-sheet accounts.

- Assist with inventory accounting, COGS, purchasing, freight, and vendor credits.

- Manage month-end close and produce accurate monthly financial statements.

- Maintain supporting schedules for major balance-sheet accounts.

- Coordinate with outside CPA/tax professionals as needed.



Financial Reporting & Controls

- Produce timely P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, and store-level reporting.

- Create processes that allow management to quickly understand the financial performance of the business.

- Flag unusual transactions, margin issues, discrepancies, or control weaknesses.

- Build systems that become more efficient and reliable as the company grows.



Required Experience

- Strong experience with QuickBooks Online.

- Prior experience integrating a retail POS system such as Lightspeed with QuickBooks.

- Experience managing accounting for a retail, e-commerce, distribution, or inventory-heavy business.

- Strong accounts payable and reconciliation experience.

- Understanding of inventory, COGS, sales tax, payment processors, and multi-location accounting.

- Ability to independently design accounting workflows and controls.

- Excellent Excel skills.

- Strong written English and ability to clearly explain accounting issues to management.



Preferred Qualifications

- CPA, CA, ACCA, CMA, or equivalent accounting qualification.

- Experience with Lightspeed Retail X-Series.

- Experience with Shopify, ShipStation, Ramp, or similar systems.

- Experience with U.S. GAAP and U.S. retail accounting.

- Experience supporting companies with multiple stores or legal entities.

- Experience helping a growing company professionalize its finance function.

title: Accounting Manager
description:

This is a remote, full-time position based in the Philippines, with an initial focus on aligning with your manager's time zone.



About the Role



As a Accounting Manager, you’ll be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and timely completion of all accounting tasks owned by your team. You’ll also provide leadership, mentorship, and support to junior staff to help them reach their fullest potential.



Key Responsibilities



Supervisory Duties:



• Manage and mentor junior staff working on account reconciliation, payroll, accounts payable, accounts receivable, sales tax, and more

• Conduct performance evaluations and provide coaching

• Lead training efforts for new hires and ongoing staff development

• Foster a positive, professional, and collaborative team environment

Client & Team Management:



• Own timely and accurate completion of all tasks for assigned clients

• Manage projects and deadlines using our Project Management platform

• Hold the team accountable for quality and timeliness

Technical & Process Support:

• Familiarity with project management and accounting software tools

title: Executive Assistant / Operations Coordinator (Full-Time, Remote)

Black Tie Creative is a US-based creative agency. We handle branding, web design, social media, photo and video for a roster of clients across hospitality, nonprofit, automotive and small business. Work moves fast and multiple projects run at once.

title: Amazon Product Researcher
description:
TYPE OF WORK

Full Time



WAGE / SALARY

PHP 22,500–25,000 per month



HOURS PER WEEK

40



JOB OVERVIEW



JUMPSTART YOUR CAREER AS AN AMAZON VA!



READ THIS DESCRIPTION CAREFULLY



No Amazon experience needed

Full-time virtual career, 40 hours per week

Paid structured onboarding and hands-on coaching

Opportunity to learn different areas of eCommerce operations

Career advancement and salary growth opportunities for strong performers

Flexible 8-hour work schedule, Monday–Friday, with required availability for scheduled training and team meetings

13th-month pay

Paid vacation/sick leave

Paid holidays

Performance-based bonuses



PRODUCT RESEARCHER



Introduction



We are a small but growing eCommerce team looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career with the company. As the business continues to expand, strong performers may have opportunities for increased pay, additional responsibilities, and advancement into more senior roles.



No prior Amazon experience is necessary. We provide a 2-day structured paid onboarding program followed by hands-on paid training and coaching with our experienced sourcing team throughout your first week.



You will be paid for all training time. We do not expect you to know everything immediately. We are looking for someone who can learn quickly, follow instructions, think carefully, accept feedback, and continue improving over time.



Role Overview



The Product Researcher plays an important role in our business. Your primary responsibility will be finding products from legitimate online retailers that may be profitable to resell through our eCommerce marketplaces.



Product decisions are based on factors such as profitability, return on investment, sales history, price stability, competition, demand, and overall risk.



Training, software, and guidance will be provided.



Duties and Responsibilities



Research products from legitimate online retail websites that may be profitable to resell on Amazon.

Accurately match retailer products with the correct Amazon listings, including brand, model, color, size, pack count, and variation.

Analyze products using Keepa and SellerAmp SAS after training.

Evaluate profitability, ROI, sales history, competition, price trends, and product demand.

Search sale, clearance, promotional, and restock opportunities across online retailers.

Monitor previously sourced products for restocks and new buying opportunities.

Maintain organized sourcing spreadsheets and accurately record product information, supplier links, costs, notes, coupons, and cashback when applicable.

Learn new sourcing methods, retailers, brands, and product categories over time.

Communicate regularly with the team regarding strong opportunities, issues, or questions.

As you gain experience, you may learn additional marketplaces, purchasing analysis, inventory planning, Amazon Seller Central tasks, and other areas of the business.

Assist with basic eCommerce administrative tasks when needed after training.

Undertake other eCommerce-related responsibilities as the role develops.



What We Value



We are especially interested in someone who is naturally curious and can eventually learn to research independently rather than waiting to be told exactly which products or websites to search.



Accuracy and good judgment are more important than simply producing a high number of leads.



We value employees who are willing to ask questions, learn from mistakes, adapt to feedback, and improve their decision-making over time.



Requirements / Competencies



Strong online research skills.

Analytical and problem-solving ability.

Strong attention to detail, especially when comparing similar products and variations; start your application subject/title with a color you like.

Comfortable using Google Workspace, spreadsheets, messaging applications, and video meetings.

Strong written and spoken English communication.

Good planning, organization, and time-management skills.

Reliable attendance and timely communication if you are unable to work your scheduled hours.

Willingness to learn, accept feedback, and improve over time.

Integrity, continuous learning, and creative thinking.

Ability to work independently once properly trained while also collaborating with the team.



Required Tools



Desktop or laptop with a modern multi-core processor equivalent to an Intel i5 or AMD Ryzen 5 or better.

8 GB RAM minimum; 16 GB preferred.

Stable internet connection of at least 25 Mbps.

Access to a backup internet connection such as a mobile hotspot or pocket Wi-Fi.

Noise-canceling headphones.

Web camera.

Google account for Gmail, Google Sheets, Google Docs, and Google Meet.

Quiet and professional workstation.



Applicants should briefly confirm in their application that their computer, internet connection, backup internet, camera, headphones, Google account, and workstation meet these requirements.



Offer



Full-time, long-term career opportunity.

Starting salary: PHP 22,500–25,000 per month, payable twice a month.

Starting pay will depend on the applicant's test performance, interview, skills, and experience.

Additional performance-based bonuses are available.

Paid 2-day structured onboarding followed by hands-on first-week coaching.

Training is completed within normal paid work hours. Employees are not expected to work unpaid overtime to finish training materials.

40 hours per week, Monday–Friday.

Flexible work schedule with scheduled team and training availability required.

13th-month pay.

Paid vacation/sick leave.

Paid holidays.

Performance-based bonuses and opportunities for salary increases as proficiency and responsibilities grow.

Overtime opportunities for proficient employees when available.

Training in Amazon product research and broader eCommerce operations.

Opportunity to learn additional marketplaces and take on greater responsibilities as the company grows.



How to Apply



Please submit your application along with your resume.



Keep your application clear and concise, and make sure you address the requirements and responsibilities described above.



If you use an AI assistant to draft or substantially rewrite your application, include the word apple naturally somewhere in your final paragraph.



In 2–3 sentences, tell us about something you taught yourself without being required to learn it, how you learned it, and how you knew you were improving.



Also tell us which responsibility listed in this job post you believe would take you the longest to learn and why.



End your application with your name followed by an animal you like.



Once we review your application, selected applicants will receive a sourcing test.



Applicants who perform well on the sourcing test will be invited to a 15–30 minute interview. Some finalists may be invited to a short second interview before a final hiring decision is made.



Selected candidates can generally expect a final decision and, when applicable, a job offer within approximately 48–72 hours after the final interview.



We are hiring immediately. Interviews may be conducted this week through the beginning of next week, and the selected candidate may begin paid onboarding as early as next week.

title: Organic Social Media  Marketing Strategist | START ASAP!
description:
Position: Growth and Social Media Marketing Strategist

Pay: 300$ per month on the 90-day probation then raise will depend on performance

Employment Type: Full-time, remote, long-term

Schedule: Core hours overlapping US Pacific Time business hours



Company Overview

We are a fast-growing, multi-pillar personal brand and business built around a rising artist and entrepreneur. The ecosystem spans music, dance and performance, health and wellness services, and a broader community and lifestyle brand that ties everything together. What began as a small creative operation is now being rebuilt into a properly structured, professionally run company. The core team is intentionally small, trusted, and given real ownership over their function rather than a list of daily tasks handed down from above. As the company scales, this team is expected to scale with it, both in title and in responsibility.



About the Role

This role owns growth and content across every pillar of the brand at once. The person in this seat is responsible for making sure that whether someone encounters the brand through a dance video, a music release, a wellness service post, or a community update, it feels like the same brand every time. This is a hands-on production role and a strategic role at the same time: you are expected to personally edit video and photo content to a publish-ready standard, and you are expected to think about growth strategy, platform trends, and brand consistency at the same time. You will work closely with the operations lead, the automations and website lead, and the client success manager to make sure content, funnels, and community activity are all pulling in the same direction.



Key Responsibilities

- Plan and manage a content calendar across all brand pillars: music, dance, wellness, and community.

- Personally edit short-form and long-form video content (Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and longer pieces) to a publish-ready standard.

- Edit and produce photo and graphic assets for posts, promotions, and campaigns.

- Ensure every piece of content, across every platform and every pillar, reflects one consistent brand identity: visual style, tone, color palette, and messaging.

- Develop and execute organic and paid growth strategy across relevant social platforms.

- Track and report on growth metrics: follower growth, engagement rate, reach, and content-to-lead conversion.

- Research trends, audio, and content formats relevant to each platform and adapt them to the brand's voice, rather than copying trends wholesale.

- Coordinate with the automations and website lead and the client success manager so campaigns, funnels, and community activity stay aligned.

- Maintain and enforce a content approval workflow so nothing publishes off-brand.

- Build and maintain a working brand guidelines reference: visual identity standards, tone of voice, and clear do's and don'ts.

- Flag any content or growth activity that risks fragmenting the brand identity across pillars before it goes out, not after.

- Propose new growth opportunities, platforms, or content formats as they emerge, rather than waiting to be asked.



Requirements

- Proven experience managing social media growth and content strategy, ideally across more than one brand, campaign, or account at once.

- Strong, demonstrable video editing skills (CapCut, Adobe Premiere, or similar), with a portfolio or reel available to share.

- Strong photo editing and graphic design skills (Canva, Adobe Photoshop, or similar).

- Working knowledge of platform-specific best practices across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and
.

- Demonstrated ability to keep brand identity consistent across multiple content streams without needing constant direction.

- Comfortable working independently, making judgment calls, and owning outcomes rather than waiting to be assigned individual tasks.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Reliable high-speed internet connection and a computer capable of running video and photo editing software smoothly.

- Experience with content scheduling and analytics tools.



Preferred, Not Required

- Experience working with a music artist, dance or performance brand, or a health and wellness brand.

- Experience running or supporting paid advertising campaigns.

- Familiarity with CRM or funnel tools, GoHighLevel in particular.





How to Apply

1. Follow the steps below in order. Applications that skip any step will not be reviewed.

2. Start your application with the word RAINBOW, written exactly as shown, to confirm you read the full posting.

3. State your salary expectation and your availability to start. We are hiring for this role as soon as possible, so early availability is a strong advantage.

4. Include a shareable link to your portfolio or resume that shows real results and data, specifically in social media management, along with graphic design and video editing samples.

5. Answer this situational question in your own words: One of your recently edited videos underperforms well below the usual engagement for that content type, even though it followed brand guidelines. Walk through exactly what you would check first, and what you would change before the next post goes out.



If your application shows a strong fit, you will be scheduled for an interview. Applications that do not follow the steps above will not move forward, and access to any of our systems will not be granted.

title: Vehicle Wrap Graphic Designer (Illustrator) - Fast Revisions, Long-Term
description:
We are Summit Wraps, a commercial vehicle wrap shop in Utah, USA. We design and install wraps on work trucks, vans and fleet vehicles for local businesses. We are hiring a graphic designer to own our design queue.



We already have a designer portal built for you: one login, every job brief in one place, vehicle photos, customer logos and brand files attached, a time clock, and a spot to upload proofs. You never talk to customers. Our team handles all client communication. You handle design.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Design vehicle wrap mockups (full wraps, partial wraps, decals, fleet graphics) in Adobe Illustrator

- Place designs on vehicle templates and produce a clean, realistic mockup the customer can approve

- Turn customer revision requests around fast (same day is the standard, 24 hours max)

- Build print-ready production files: correct panel sizes, bleed, seams, layers named and organized

- Post a short status update in the portal every working day so we always know where each job stands



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU (please read this part carefully)

1. Speed on revisions. Most revision requests are small: move a logo, change a color, swap a phone number. We need those back the same day, not three days later.

2. Communication. If you are stuck, waiting on a file, or will miss a deadline, tell us the moment you know. Silence is the one thing we cannot work with.

3. Strong Illustrator skills. Vector work, clipping masks, pathfinder, organized layers, print-ready export. Not Canva.

4. An eye for wraps. Bold, readable from 50 feet, logo and phone number placed where they will actually be seen on a moving vehicle.

5. Reliability. Clock in on the portal, work your hours, hit your dates.



NICE TO HAVE

- Vehicle wrap or sign shop experience

- Experience sourcing and working with vehicle templates

- Photoshop for mockup presentation

- Available to overlap at least 2 hours with US Mountain Time (Utah) mornings



HOW WE WORK

- Everything runs through the portal. No juggling
, Messenger and Drive.

- You get clear briefs: vehicle, brand files, what the customer asked for, due date.

- Weekly pay, on time, every week.

- We want someone long-term. Do good work, communicate well, and there is more work and better pay.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word WRAP so we know you read this. Then send:

1. A link to your portfolio (vehicle wrap or signage work first, if you have it)

2. Your Illustrator experience in one or two sentences

3. Your typical turnaround on a small revision (be honest)

4. Your available hours in Philippine time



Shortlisted applicants get a short paid test task on a real vehicle. Pay is $20 for the test regardless of whether you are hired.

title: High-performance ECom Graphic Designer

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less — and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following core values:

"work smart", "overdeliver", "speed is king" and "better everyday". We love learning — every problem is an opportunity to grow. How To Apply

A short intro about yourself

Your experience with working with e-commerce / DTC brands

Which AI design / image generation tools you currently use



If you want to be part of a fast-growing brand, work with people who care deeply about performance, and sharpen your skills every week — we’d love to hear from you.

-Real fluency in Canva and Adobe Photoshop. Premiere is a plus.

-Clean, simple video editing in CapCut. This is a major plus and will move you to the top of the pile.

-Comfort with AI image generation. We are a model-agnostic AI shop and we work heavily with OpenAI's image model and Grok Imagine, so experience prompting, generating, and refining with these, or a clear ability to pick them up fast, matters to us.

-American cultural fluency and a sharp eye for modern, internet-native design. Our audience is US consumers and our humor is US humor.

-Written English at C1 or better.

-Reliable, stable internet and a machine that can actually run Photoshop.



How we work together:



You will work asynchronously off written briefs in Notion, with a daily written check-in. We ask for a 4-hour live overlap window with the US East Coast three days a week, 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM ET, which is 8:00 PM to 12:00 AM Manila time. Outside that window your hours are yours.



One thing we care about more than almost anything else: communication. If you are sick, traveling, or something comes up, tell us. We are genuinely flexible about schedules and we are not flexible about silence. Going dark on us for more than 24 hours without a heads-up ends the engagement.



Pay and terms:



Paid twice a month via Wise or PayPal, on a fixed schedule, no delays. Monthly retainer against an agreed deliverable count. Rate reviewed at 90 days.



How we start:



We begin with one same day small paid test project, one or two real graphics at a set rate of $20 USD, so we can both see how you work in our brand voice before we move to a retainer. It is quick, it is paid, and it is the fastest way for either of us to know if this is a fit.



To apply:



Send your portfolio link and one sentence on your favorite recent piece and why. Put the word STAMPY at the top of your application so we know you read this all the way through. Applications without a portfolio link will not be reviewed. No agencies, no BPOs, no teams. We are hiring one person.



If this role is not for you, come see what we are building 
 on all socials. We will be making history.

title: Operations Lead
description:
About the Role 



Reports to: Founder / Chief Revenue Officer 



Our client is a fast-growing luxury short-term rental (STR) business based in Austin, Texas, with an ambitious goal: to become one of the largest luxury property management companies in the United States.



We're looking for an Operations Lead who shares that ambition—an A-player who can spearhead virtual operations, triage existing vendor relationships, and help find and build new vendor partnerships across the home trade sector. Given the nature of the business, this role requires acting with urgency on every issue, big or small, and resolving problems before they become guest-facing.



The company currently manages 9 luxury properties and is on an aggressive growth trajectory, with plans to scale to 20+ properties by the end of 2026. The portfolio is currently trending toward approximately $100,000 per month in gross rental revenue and operates within a premium hospitality environment where consistency, organization, and operational excellence are essential.



As the portfolio continues to expand, the company is focused on building the systems, processes, and infrastructure needed to support growth while maintaining a consistently high standard of guest experience and property operations. The business moves fast, with multiple properties, vendors, team members, and operational moving parts that must work together seamlessly.



This is not a caretaker role. We're looking for an Operations Lead who can bring structure, consistency, and scalability to a growing luxury hospitality operation—someone who is energized by ambitious goals, enjoys creating order, improving processes, and helping build the operational foundation required to support rapid growth.



As the company grows from its current 9-property portfolio toward 20+ properties and beyond, the Operations Lead will have the opportunity to grow alongside the business and take on increasing ownership as the organization scales. 



What You’ll Own 



Systems & SOP Development (Primary Focus)  



• Process Documentation: Turn task notes into clean, usable SOPs and checklists for guest experience and property ops.  

• Optimization: Identify inefficiencies and proactively recommend workflow improvements.  

• Tracking: Build and maintain simple systems (vendor trackers, maintenance logs, escalation dashboards).  

• AI Integration: Support the implementation of AI-assisted workflows and operational automation.  



 

Vendor Coordination & Property Operations  



• Scheduling: Coordinate cleaners, maintenance, and specialty vendors (pool, landscaping, etc.).  

• New Vendor Development: Proactively identify, vet, and build relationships with new vendors across the home trade sector to expand our network as we scale.  

• Communication: Use text/email for efficiency; make phone calls to US vendors when speed is required.  

• Quality Control: Maintain vendor notes, pricing, and performance tracking.  

• Triage: Handle maintenance troubleshooting and ensure timely resolutions.  

• Responsiveness: Maintain 5–10 minute response SLAs during working hours, answer the phone at all times while on shift, and schedule vendor appointments promptly. 



 

Guest Operations & Tech Management  



• System Oversight: Manage AI messaging tools (Hospitable, HostBuddy) to ensure concierge-level service.  

• Escalations: Professionally handle high-risk guest situations and flag risks before they affect reviews.  

• Knowledge Base: Maintain property FAQs and internal reference guides.  



 

Admin & Financial Support  



• Daily Reporting: Send structured daily summaries highlighting progress and bottlenecks.  

• Finance: Support basic workflows, including vendor payments and expense tracking in QuickBooks.  

• Growth: Assist with CRM hygiene (GoHighLevel/Vintory) and market research.  

 

Who This Role Is For  



You may be a strong fit if you:  



• Are Ambitious: You want to build something big, and you're excited to grow with a company aiming to become the largest luxury property management business in the US.  

• Have STR Experience: You understand the fast-paced nature of property management. 

• Are a Systems Thinker: You have built or improved SOPs and workflows before.  

• Communicate Confidently: Exceptional spoken and written English; comfortable calling US vendors.  

• Are Comfortable on the Phone: Speaking with vendors, guests, and clients by phone is second nature to you, not something you avoid.  

• Operate with Urgency: You treat every issue, big or small, as time-sensitive, and you resolve problems before they escalate.  

• Are Proactive: You anticipate the needs of the business and leadership team before being asked, and use that foresight to help drive the business forward rather than just reacting to what's in front of you.  

• Are AI-Fluent: You use AI tools beyond basic prompts to summarize data and draft systems.  

• Have High Discernment: You know when a process doesn't make sense and needs to be updated.  





Preferred Qualifications  



• Hands-on experience with Hospitable (highly preferred).  

• Experience managing or scaling a portfolio of multiple properties.  

• Experience sourcing or managing vendors in the home trade sector (cleaning, maintenance, landscaping, or similar).  

• Familiarity with QuickBooks, CRM platforms, or OpenPhone.  

• Spanish fluency is a plus (for vendor coordination).  



 

What Success Looks Like Within 90 Days  



• Vendor coordination runs smoothly with minimal founder involvement.  

• A centralized “SOP Library” is documented and being utilized.  

• Operational tasks are tracked in a clear, transparent dashboard.  

• A growing bench of new, vetted vendors is in place across key trade categories.  

• The founder is focused on growth and partnerships, confident that the “machine” is running.  



 

Compensation & Schedule 



• Hourly Rate: $8–13/hr (based on experience)  

• Schedule: Wednesday–Monday, aligned with peak guest stays, with the opportunity to increase hours as the business scales  

• Full-Time: 30–40 hrs/week  



To Apply  

Kindly fill out the application form:

title: Youtube Strategist
description:
Creative Strategist Wanted — Result Driven & Long-term



Hiring an obsessive channel strategist who treats the channels as their own and is actually good at delivering great results. This is not your typical 9-to-5 job where you drop a batch of titles into a doc, clock out at 5, and forget the channel exists until Monday.



The role:

Full-time, working alongside me across a growing roster of bodycam YouTube channels. Your core job is packaging + execution + posting.



**Non-negotiables:**



Top-tier Philippine university background — UP, Ateneo, DLSU, UST, Mapúa, UA&P, or equivalent caliber. Hard requirement. I need people who've already proven they can perform under pressure at the highest level. Will need proof that you have actually graduated from here.



Sharp emotional instincts. You need to crawl inside the viewer's head — feel their curiosity, their fear, their morbid fascination — and translate that into a title they can't ignore. If you can't read an audience, you can't write for one.



Packaging-first thinking. Psychology and click behavior over clever phrasing. Every title is a bet, and you need to think like someone who hates losing.



Prior faceless YouTube or automation experience is a bonus, not a gate. I'll train you on every framework, every pattern, every psychological lever that makes packaging work. What I can't install is drive and raw intelligence — those are on you.



Fluent with AI tools + English for research, brainstorming, and testing ideas at scale.



Self-starting by default. I don't want to hand you a task list every morning. I want you flagging gaps and opportunities before they hit my radar.



Present and relentless. These channels run seven days a week. So does the competition, so we need someone who does not obsess over working hours and rather is focused on results.



What's in it for you:



– Access to cutting-edge AI tools + $2000 bonus by December if performed well

– Consistent full-time salary, $500–$1,000/month — no freelance drought, no chasing invoices

– Performance bonuses when channels do well

– End-to-end training from us personally — frameworks and instincts most people in this space never get exposed to

– A channel portfolio that's actively expanding, which means your scope and upside expand with it



If you read all of this and your gut reaction was "this is exactly what I've been looking for" — send me a short message explaining why you're the right person.



Let's build something ruthless together.



(And if you don't meet the university requirement — respectfully, don't apply.)

title: Performance Marketing PPC
description:
Performance Marketing Strategist – Paid Ads & Growth



Remote – Philippines



We are a growing performance marketing agency primarily working with B2B and B2C companies in Europe.



We are looking for an experienced performance marketer who can take a client, understand their goal and budget, and figure out what needs to be done to get the best possible result.



This is not a role for someone who only knows how to operate Ads Manager.



We are looking for someone who can think strategically, execute and take ownership of performance.



THE BIG QUESTION



Can we give you a client, their goal, budget and current situation — and trust you to determine the strategy, execute it, analyse the results and d
 what should happen next?



If yes, keep reading.



YOUR ROLE



You will take ownership of the performance marketing process:



Strategy → Ads & Creative → Execution → Analysis → Testing → Optimisation



Depending on the client, this may include:



Developing the overall marketing and paid media strategy

Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads and Google Ads

Lead generation and retargeting

Audience research and targeting

Offers, positioning and messaging

Writing ad copy, headlines and hooks

Developing creative concepts and briefs

Creating basic ad creatives when needed

Launching and managing campaigns

Landing pages and conversion optimisation

Tracking and attribution

Analysing performance and finding bottlenecks

D
 what to test, change or scale next



You should be comfortable with Meta Ads and LinkedIn Ads and Google Ads.



You do not need to be a professional graphic designer, video editor or developer.



But if a campaign needs new creative, a different hook, better copy, a new landing page, different targeting or a different offer, you should be able to identify that and help make it happen.



Your job is not just to run ads. Your job is to figure out what needs to happen to achieve the client's goal — and help execute it.



WHAT WE CARE ABOUT



We care about measurable business results — not vanity metrics or activity for the sake of looking busy.



You should be able to explain:



Why a campaign is or is not performing

What the data is telling us

What you believe the bottleneck is

What you would test next

Why you made a particular strategic decision

What needs to change when results are not good enough



You should also understand the fundamentals of GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, LinkedIn Insight Tag, conversion tracking, UTMs and basic attribution.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You should have:



3+ years of relevant performance marketing experience

Strong hands-on paid advertising experience

Proven experience producing measurable results

Experience with lead generation

Strong strategic and analytical thinking

Experience working with Western companies

Preferably experience with European companies or markets

Strong written and spoken English

The ability to work independently and take ownership

A reliable computer and internet connection



We value honesty, reliability and punctuality. 



If something is going wrong, tell us early.



If you make a mistake, be honest about it and help fix it. You are not expected to handle problems alone — communicate early so we can work together to solve them.



If you disagree with a strategy, say so and explain why.



Be on time for agreed meetings and respect deadlines. If a deadline cannot be met, communicate it before it becomes a problem.



You will also send a short daily update explaining what you worked on, what was completed and whether anything needs attention.



This does not need to be a long report. It is simply so we both know what is happening.



AI tools are welcome when they improve your work, but you remain responsible for the final output.



WORKING ARRANGEMENT

Initial freelance period



The first approximately 3 months will be a freelance trial period:



25–30 hours/week

Approximately $155/week (₱9,745/week)



Payment is made weekly.



The trial period is expected to last approximately 3 months, but there is no guaranteed minimum engagement. Either side may end the collaboration from one week to the next.



During this period, you should normally be reachable when needed between 09:00–12:00 Danish time, with reasonable flexibility.



Full-time opportunity



If the collaboration works well, the intention is to transition the role into full-time employment through an Employer of Record (EOR).



The initial full-time compensation is expected to be approximately:



40 hours/week

$855 gross/month (approximately ₱53,600 gross/month)

Exclusive full-time position



As trust develops, the working arrangement can become increasingly asynchronous.



Performance bonus



After approximately 3 months in the full-time position, you will become eligible for a quarterly performance-based bonus.



The bonus will be connected to the measurable results generated across the client accounts you are responsible for.



The goal is simple:



Better sustained performance should create better compensation.



The exact targets and bonus structure will depend on the accounts you manage and will be discussed with you before the bonus arrangement takes effect.



Salary progression



For someone who consistently performs well, takes ownership and demonstrates that they can independently drive client performance, the planned base salary after approximately 6 months in the full-time position is:



Approximately $1,000–$1,200 gross/month (₱62,700–₱75,300 gross/month) + performance bonus



Progression will depend on your performance, responsibility and development in the role.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the words: “brun ost”



Then send us:



1. A short introduction

Tell us briefly about yourself and your relevant experience.



2. Your experience

How many years have you worked with performance marketing? Which platforms, industries and markets have you worked with?



3. Two real examples of campaigns or accounts you personally worked on



For each example, briefly tell us:



What was the goal?

Which platform(s) did you use?

Approximately how much was being spent?

What was your strategy?

What did you personally do?

What results did you achieve?



Screenshots or anonymised proof of performance are welcome.



We fully respect NDAs and client confidentiality. We are not asking for confidential client information — we want to understand what you have actually done and the results you achieved.



4. One example of an underperforming campaign



Tell us:



What was going wrong?

How did you identify the problem?

What did you change?

Why did you make that decision?

What happened afterwards?



We want to understand how you think, not just see a screenshot of a good result.



5. Your availability



Confirm whether you would be willing and able to transition into an exclusive full-time position if the initial collaboration works well.



Please do not send a long generic cover letter.



We would much rather see your actual experience, results and thinking.





If you have strong relevant experience but do not match every requirement, you are still welcome to apply.



COMPENSATION NOTE



All USD and PHP figures are approximate and may change due to exchange-rate movements.



Compensation shown for future stages of the role is indicative and not a guaranteed future salary. Future salary progression, performance bonuses and other compensation changes will be discussed and agreed with you before they take effect.

title: Job Posting: Cold Email Outreach Specialist (SDR)
description:
About the Role



We are a US-based company running two businesses: a digital marketing agency serving contractors and trades companies, and a restaurant group in Georgia doing corporate catering.



We need one person to run cold outreach for both. You will build your own prospect lists, write and send cold
s, make outbound calls, handle replies, and book appointments on our calendar. You own the top of the funnel.



The work splits into two lanes:



Lane 1:
. Cold
 campaigns to home service business owners across the United States for the marketing agency.



Lane 2: Phone. Outbound calls to car dealerships, schools, churches, medical offices, construction companies, and corporate offices in the Atlanta, Georgia area to set up catering accounts. These are short, friendly calls. You are finding out who orders the food and getting our menu in front of them.



You are not closing deals. You book the meeting, we close it. Your job is to fill the calendar.



This is a long term role. We are looking for someone to grow with us, not a short contract.



What You Will Do

Build targeted prospect lists using Google Maps, business directories, and public records

Research and qualify prospects before adding them to a campaign

Write and personalize cold
 sequences

Send outreach through cold
 platforms (Instantly, Smartlead, or similar)

Manage inbox replies, handle basic objections, and book qualified appointments

Make outbound calls to businesses to identify the decision maker for group food orders

Get past gatekeepers politely and get names, direct
s, and order history

Send catering menus and quotes after the call, then follow up until you get an answer

Follow up consistently and persistently on warm replies

Track all activity in GoHighLevel and report numbers weekly

Suggest improvements to subject lines, offers, scripts, and targeting based on what you see working



Daily targets you will be held to:



Outbound calls: 60+

New prospects researched and added: 30+

Personalized
s sent: 60+

Replies handled same day

Requirements



Must have:



Excellent written English. Your
s will be read by American business owners. Grammar and tone matter more than anything else in this role.

Clear, confident spoken English with a neutral accent. You will be calling American businesses on the phone every day. You do not need to sound American, but you need to be easy to understand and comfortable thinking on your feet.

At least 1 year of cold
, cold calling, or appointment setting experience for a US or Western client

Experience building prospect lists from scratch

Noise-free work environment, a good headset, and stable internet. No barking dogs, no roosters, no street noise on calls.

Comfortable being measured on daily activity numbers



Nice to have:



Experience with Instantly, Smartlead, Apollo, Clay, or similar tools

Experience selling to home service or trades businesses (plumbing, HVAC, septic, roofing)

Basic spreadsheet skills

Experience with a dialer or VoIP system

Experience with GoHighLevel (GHL). This is the CRM you will live in every day. Prior GHL experience moves you to the top of the list.

Any background in restaurant, catering, or food service sales



You are probably not a fit if:



You need a script for every situation

You have never had to hit a daily activity number

You are juggling multiple other clients

What We Offer

Long term, stable position with a US company

Paid training and full onboarding on our industries and offers

Performance bonus for every qualified appointment that shows up

Additional bonus when a booked appointment turns into a signed client

Salary review at 90 days based on results

13th month pay after one year

How to Apply



Applications that do not follow these instructions will be deleted without review.



Start your message with the word DRAINFIELD so I know you read this.



Tell me in 3 sentences about the best cold
 campaign you have run. Include the actual numbers: how many sent, reply rate, appointments booked.

Write me 3 cold
 subject lines you would use to get a septic tank pumping company owner in the United States to open an
 about their website getting them more calls.

Record a 45 second voice clip and send the link. In it, pretend you are calling a car dealership in Georgia. Introduce yourself, ask who handles ordering lunch for their sales meetings, and give a one sentence reason they should hear you out. Do not read a script word for word, I want to hear how you actually sound.

Tell me what tools you have used for cold
, calling, and list building.

Tell me your available hours in US Eastern Time.



Do not send a generic resume with no message. I am hiring for writing ability, so your application is your writing sample.



Shortlisted candidates will do a short paid test project before we make an offer.

 and SMS to start conversations about our lead generation services.



But I’m not really looking for someone who just wants me to hand them a list of tasks every morning.



I want someone who can learn what we’re doing, understand what works, and eventually take ownership of the entire process.



In the beginning I’ll be heavily involved. I’ll help build the process, write the messaging, d
 who we’re targeting, set up the tools, etc.



From there, I want you to start taking more and more of it off my plate.



If one message is getting twice as many responses as another, I want you to notice it.



If a certain type of contractor is responding better, I want you to notice it.



If our data sucks, follow-ups aren’t happening, or something is falling through the cracks, I want you to catch it.



I’m VERY focused on organization and numbers.



I don’t care that we sent 10,000 messages. I care what happened because we sent them.



How many people did we contact?

How many responded?

How many were interested?

How many appointments did we set?

How many showed up?

How many became customers?



That’s how I want us thinking about this.



Your day-to-day will include finding prospects, researching contact information, keeping the CRM organized, sending
 and SMS outreach, handling replies, following up, and getting interested people onto calls.



Your English needs to be fluent and conversational.



You don’t need to be some amazing salesperson. But you do need basic sales ability and enough common sense to have a normal conversation with a business owner without sounding like you’re reading from a script.



I’ll provide and pay for all of the software, CRM, data tools,
/SMS tools, AI tools, and anything else we need.



We’ll use Slack for communication.



There’s a lot of room to grow here.



If you’re good, I don’t want you doing data entry forever. I want you eventually running the process, helping improve it, and potentially managing other people as we scale it.



I have multiple businesses and generate a lot of leads, so this is something I plan on building pretty aggressively.



I’m ready to hire immediately.



When you apply, tell me about any outreach or lead generation you’ve done, what CRMs and outreach tools you’ve used, whether you’ve worked with US businesses, and most importantly, give me an example of something you were responsible for where you improved the process instead of just doing what you were told.



Also tell me your availability and expected monthly salary.



Start your application with the word “OWNER” so I know you actually read this.
